name: Doctors
description: Set in the fictional Midlands town of Letherbridge, defined as being close to the city of Birmingham, this soap opera follows the staff and families of a doctor's surgery.

videos.title: They Can't Take That Away From Me
A Home's Not Where The Heart Is
A Matter Of Life And Death

I Saw Mommy Kissing Santa Claus

Always Something There To Remind Me
The Things We Do For Love

The Other Side Of The Fence

A Rock And A Hard Place
You Make Me Feel So Young

Still Crazy After All These Years

videos.overview: A daughter thinks her mother is back on drugs, but George proves her wrong. Jimmi tells George he wants to be a dad.

videos.title: Turning Out
videos.overview: As the voices in his head increase, a teenage boy struggles to cope. Emily visits from Boston to deal with an important matter while Julia and Melody are missing Vivien.

videos.title: School's Out
videos.overview: When a school boy is attacked, his teacher has to make a tough personal decision. George and Ronnie attend counselling while Nick faces a new challenge.

videos.title: Words Left Unsaid
videos.overview: Joe meets three sisters whose bitter rivalries overshadow their father's impending death. Emily has lunch with Nick, while Archie's jealousy of Daniel finally reaches boiling point.

videos.title: Speak Up
videos.overview: Michelle is shocked to meet a face from the past. Daniel and Archie are called in to explain the fight while Joe makes a big decision.

videos.title: All In A Name
videos.overview: When a teenage boy tries to hire his services, Ronnie uncovers a hidden crime. Joe says his goodbyes to the Mill and Letherbridge while George and Ronnie have a positive counselling session.

videos.title: Lady Muck
videos.overview: When a shameless gossip stumbles across something serious she enlists Archie's help to save a man's life. An old friend from the police station is upset to hear that Jimmi has split up with Eva.

videos.title: Stabbed In The Back
videos.overview: Daniel is confronted by an angry man with a big truck. Jimmi goes in search of Maisie. Ronnie returns home.

videos.title: Eye Of The Beholder
videos.overview: Michelle goes to treat a reclusive spinster and makes a surprising discovery. Maisie, the only lead Eva has in a murder case, goes missing.

videos.title: And The Winner Is
videos.overview: Vivien is the reluctant winner of a competition. Eva finally gets some sense out of Maisie, who then sets up camp outside the station.

videos.title: Searching
videos.overview: Nick helps a young girl in care who refuses to believe that her mother is dead. Eva tells Jimmi she has put in for a transfer.

videos.title: A Pain in The...
videos.overview: Archie gets embroiled in an argument with a traffic warden who is worried about his future. Julie bumps into an old friend at a PCT meeting who hints there may be an opening for The Mill to expand.

videos.title: Shine A Light On
videos.overview: Melody clashes with Julia over a teenage mother who is paranoid about her baby's health. Jimmi has a horrible day when a lecture he is giving goes wrong.

videos.title: The Awakening
videos.overview: Reality becomes confusing when recurring dreams start to dominate a man's thoughts.

videos.title: Tear Away
videos.overview: Archie gets involved in a dispute between a loutish OAP and his neighbour. Julia and Nick clash over the bid for the campus surgery.

videos.title: Hidden Demons
videos.overview: George becomes convinced that acupuncture may have released a patient's old demons. Julia, Nick and Michelle find chaos at the campus surgery.

videos.title: Standing Up
videos.overview: Melody has to intervene to protect the newfound independence of a disabled woman. Daniel feels isolated when he's left out of the new surgery bid.

videos.title: Imitation Of Life
videos.overview: Vivien is suspicious when her friend is given the chance of a new life abroad by her long-lost brother. Julia gets a nasty shock at the PCT.

videos.title: The Homecoming
videos.overview: Jimmi and Eva are forced to work together when a baby is kidnapped from St. Phil's.

videos.title: The Hex
videos.overview: Archie encounters a teenage witch who puts a spell on her mother's boyfriend then changes her mind. Is she too late?

videos.title: Crimes And Punishments
videos.overview: George and Ronnie go to a dinner party with a difference. Will their love life finally get back on track?

videos.title: Little Brother
videos.overview: Nick rushes to the rescue when a boy fears his little brother is in mortal danger. It's the day of the pitch and Julia is in need of a knight in shining armour.

videos.title: Larp
videos.overview: Michelle aids a barbarian and an elf in their quest for the hand of an elven princess. The team congratulates Daniel on yesterday's heroics, but was it enough to win the pitch?

videos.title: Interventions
videos.overview: Melody helps a couple troubled by alcoholism. Ruth has an eventful day of training with Vivien at The Mill.

videos.title: Making Your Bed
videos.overview: An overbearing woman drags her impotent husband into the surgery, but that's not all he needs help with. Nick advises.

videos.title: Making A Splash
videos.overview: When Eva generously agrees to take a colleague's place she finds herself up against Ronnie in a radio debate on modern policing. Meanwhile, Julia has trouble with the painters.

videos.title: Photo Finish
videos.overview: The Mill staff find themselves caught up in a murder mystery when the Campus Surgery celebrates its Grand Opening. Jimmi tries to ask Eva out for a drink.

videos.title: Cat Fight
videos.overview: Archie finds a solution when an asthmatic man refuses to give up his best friend, Thomas the Cat. Julia's day goes from bad to worse as she tries to keep control of the negative publicity.

videos.title: Friends Like These
videos.overview: Daniel tries to help a recovering alcoholic under pressure from more than just his own demons. And the Campus Surgery finally opens for business.

videos.title: Hearts Will Go On
videos.overview: Melody learns the difference between a Rom Com and a Tragedy when she helps a film lecturer and his student. Jimmi seizes the moment when he discovers Eva will be attending a Police Retirement Party.

videos.title: Hush Little Baby
videos.overview: Ruth helps a desperate young pregnant girl to stand up to the father of her baby. Vivien has been having problems with the buses.

videos.title: Sweet Success
videos.overview: Nick helps a boy come to terms with working in his mother's chocolate shop. Vivien announces a plan to solve her public transport problems.

videos.title: The Ticking Clock
videos.overview: When an older woman discovers she is pregnant by her younger lover the blood test shows that she is HIV positive - is the lover or her ex-husband responsible? Jimmi takes Vivien to the car auction.

videos.title: What The World Needs Now
videos.overview: Eva clashes with a charismatic preacher who believes that prayer patrols are the answer to safer streets. As Vivien decides who will give her a driving lesson, the gang meet up to discuss the lack of patients at the Campus.

videos.title: Holding On
videos.overview: Melody helps a woman come to terms with her daughter's death but not before she is hospitalised. Julia and Vivien have an eventful driving lesson.

videos.title: Life's A Beach
videos.overview: Archie comes up against an arrogant medical student with a bad case of food poisoning, which he discovers is from an unlikely source.

videos.title: It's A Sin
videos.overview: Michelle intervenes when a young couple disagree over the morning-after pill. Jimmi tries to squirm out of being Vivien's driving instructor.

videos.title: Need To Know
videos.overview: An ex-girlfriend of Nick's turns up at the Mill, eager to turn the clock back. Vivien has a disastrous driving lesson when Eva comes along for the ride.

videos.title: Walking Wounded
videos.overview: Archie helps a troubled student confront his sinister past. Davey makes a bad impression on Michelle.

videos.title: Love And War
videos.overview: George steps in when a couple who normally thrive on bickering and insults break up. Michelle sees Davey's true nature.

videos.title: No. 786
videos.overview: Jimmi gets caught up in a crisis on the 786 bus. Michelle confides in Melody about Ruth and Davey.

videos.title: The Appointed Hour
videos.overview: Vivien confronts a woman who believes she can predict the hour of her death. Ruth faces the consequences of getting a makeover from Melody and Michelle.

videos.title: Rebirth Day
videos.overview: Julia's friend decides to celebrate her 'rebirth day' by confronting her disturbing past. Michelle is horrified at what Davey has done to Ruth and urges her to leave him.

videos.title: Creature Comforts
videos.overview: Nick helps a patient who believes that her husband is having an affair. Ruth steels herself to confront Davey. Melody has a surprise guest for dinner.

videos.title: Pass The Parcel
videos.overview: George clashes with a mother refusing to give her toddler the MMR jab. Ruth returns to her and Davey's house.

videos.title: A Woman's Touch
videos.overview: Eva trusts her female intuition as she attempts to solve a murder with a chauvinistic colleague. Archie and JJ bond during football but later JJ's behaviour changes.

videos.title: Spice Wars
videos.overview: Michelle turns food critic to help a warring father and daughter to decide how to run their restaurant. Melody can't resist flirting with an old flame to make Archie jealous.

videos.title: Head And Heart
videos.overview: Daniel helps a charming headhunter to give her candidate a clean bill of health but can he do the same for her? Archie gives JJ an ultimatum.

videos.title: My Cup Runneth Over With Love
videos.overview: A musical performance outside a florist's leads Julia to help an elderly singer and miserable shop owner. Jimmi takes Vivian for a driving lesson in the country and Melody is in a dilemma when Archie tells her about JJ.

videos.title: The One
videos.overview: A teenage girl, inspired by her parents' perfect marriage, is convinced she's found 'the one' - until she makes a visit to the surgery. Archie tries to get hold of Melody while Vivien looks forward to her driving course.

videos.title: Expectations
videos.overview: Michelle helps a surrogate mother in a difficult situation. George gets closer to Daniel while Archie tries to make peace with JJ.

videos.title: A Step Too Far
videos.overview: Nick and Jimmi come into conflict over the treatment of an anxious young mum. Melody learns the truth. A visitor interrupts Jimmi and Eva's move into their new house.

videos.title: Endless Love
videos.overview: An old school friend of Ruth's asks for help in locating the man she thinks may be her father after her mother dies. Archie is in turmoil - did he do the right thing?

videos.title: Inside Out
videos.overview: Daniel faces dinner at the Woodsons' while Archie and Melody deal with the fallout from JJ's arrest.

videos.title: Geraldine Mooney's Departed
videos.overview: A woman tells Jimmi that her dead husband is blocking her hallway. Vivien takes her driving theory test, but will it all end in tears?

videos.title: A Kind of Hush
videos.overview: Jimmi comes to Vivien's aid when she doesn't show up for her driving test.

videos.title: Mummy Dearest
videos.overview: Ronnie has to sort out a thorny custody problem. Vivien's desire to behave normally makes life difficult for Jimmi.

videos.title: You'll Be a Man, My Son
videos.overview: Archie tries to help an Alzheimer's patient who thinks he is Archie's dad. A father and son give Michelle some trouble.

videos.title: Fall Upon Your Sword
videos.overview:
Julia helps a couple come to terms with a change in circumstances. Everyone suffers when Vivien is in a particularly savage mood.

When Melody asks George to look at Nick's assessment, George agrees with Nick.

videos.title: Face in the Crowd
videos.overview:
George is torn between two women claiming to be the mother of the same child, but the truth reveals a shocking secret.

Melody and Daniel find themselves in a compromising position. Vivien confronts Jimmi.

videos.title: Served Cold
videos.overview: Nick is faced with a woman scorned and her potentially dangerous form of revenge. Things go badly when Vivien attempts to take her driving test. Melody worries about what happened between her and Daniel.

videos.title: The Transfer Season
videos.overview: Eva investigates the suspicious death of a famous Italian footballer. Ruth makes a discovery about Melody and Daniel.

videos.title: Stranger on a Bridge
videos.overview: Melody becomes concerned when a mysterious woman enters the life of a wealthy family friend.

videos.title: Dare, Double Dare, Truth
videos.overview: A teenage girl will do anything to get in with her twin sister's gang, but what is really behind her actions? A face from Julia's past returns.

videos.title: Big Momma
videos.overview: Ruth is forced to take charge when a deadly spider escapes in the campus surgery. Daniel makes a new acquaintance at Gamblers Anonymous.

videos.title: The Lost Letter
videos.overview: A reformed young offender finds a letter that has serious implications for one of Archie's elderly patients. Julia and Marcia arrive in Spain.

videos.title: Home, Sweet Home
videos.overview: Ronnie is ill at ease when one of her clients behaves suspiciously about her new home. Julia makes a new friend in Spain.

videos.title: Destiny Day
videos.overview: Nick and a devastating horoscope force a bride-to-be to question her true destiny. Nick overreaches and falls flat while Julia has to nurse an overindulgent Marcia.

videos.title: Forbidden Fruit
videos.overview: When an old flame reappears in Eva's life, she struggles with temptation. Julia and Mal share a kiss but Julia soon has doubts.

videos.title: Safe
videos.overview: Jimmi puts himself at risk to convince a girl caught up in gang crime that she can be safe. Kay and Daniel's risk-taking takes a criminal turn.

videos.title: Hunky Dory
videos.overview: Michelle clashes with a retired teacher who refuses to move on after her father's death. Jimmi is called to a distressing case at St Phil's and makes a chilling find.

videos.title: Everything But the Girl
videos.overview: Ronnie discovers a disturbing truth when he visits a client's home. Kay ups the ante with Daniel at a local launderette.

videos.title: The Front Page
videos.overview:
Melody becomes a showbiz doctor for the day and galvanises a young journalist into confronting her tyrannical editor.

Nick battles with an alien-hunter who refuses to take heed of the health risks involved.

videos.title: Witness to a Wedding
videos.overview: George and Ronnie accidentally get caught up in a very surreal wedding. Kay sets Daniel his biggest challenge yet.

videos.title: Old Green Eyes
videos.overview: Archie unwittingly becomes embroiled in the love life of a fellow cyclist. Eva has more questions for Vivien about the burglary.

videos.title: One Dog Day
videos.overview: Eva gets a break in the burglary investigation. Daniel struggles to resist Kay.

videos.title: Regular Fare
videos.overview: Ruth bumps into an old family friend and uncovers a disturbing secret. Vivien attends the ID parade.

videos.title: Who Do You Think You Are Kidding?
videos.overview: Nick gets more than he bargained for when he gives evidence on behalf of a patient. Michelle and Ruth go shopping while Vivien pays an emotional visit to the hospital.

videos.title: Love Rat
videos.overview: Daniel races to prove his innocence after being accused of having an affair with a patient. Jimmi finds himself in an awkward position.

videos.title: These Prison Walls
videos.overview: Ronnie helps an ex-prisoner accused of arson. Vivien returns to the police station.

videos.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
videos.overview: Michelle helps a foreign student with food poisoning. Julia has an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Fashion First
videos.overview: Melody helps a fashion-conscious girl to put her health first. Julia is on top of the world, but is all that it seems?

videos.title: Part of You
videos.overview: Joe gets caught up in some family politics when a father needs a new kidney. Julia and Mal's picnic in the park is interrupted.

videos.title: Number One Fan
videos.overview: The reported death of a French film star causes a lonely woman to have delusions. Nick meets a flirtatious new patient.

videos.title: Maximum Load
videos.overview: Three people in denial end up in close proximity with Archie as they all get trapped in a lift. Michelle takes a shine to the new agency nurse at the Mill.

videos.title: Observation
videos.overview: Eva discovers that crime and exploitation are closer to home than she thought. George and Ronnie attempt to interrogate Mal at their dinner party.

videos.title: The Third Challenge
videos.overview: Ruth finds herself getting too close to a handsome young patient. Joe discovers that Daniel is still seeing Kay.

videos.title: The Universe Provides
videos.overview: George is taken in by a spiritual conman who threatens to sue after a homeopathic remedy causes an allergic reaction. Nick is asked out on a date, while work pressures take their toll on Joe.

videos.title: The Horrors
videos.overview: Mike helps a student with a drink problem, whilst Mal helps out at the campus.

videos.title: Girl X
videos.overview: Ronnie forces his journalist friend to face the consequences of his unsavoury actions. It's George's 40th birthday and she's expecting a big surprise.

videos.title: Eat For Two
videos.overview: A man obsessed with his pregnant wife's weight enlists Melody's help. Joe makes Daniel tell the truth about Kay.

videos.title: True Colours
videos.overview: Ruth helps a graffiti artist confront the cause of his frustrations. Michelle ups her game to her man.

videos.title: Kiss My Asp
videos.overview: It's the day of George's party, but she's not the only one with a surprise in store.

videos.title: In The Dark
videos.overview: A woman struggling to trust her previously adulterous husband turns to Nick for solutions. The gossip from George's party spreads fast, but what will Julia decide?

videos.title: Everything Counts
videos.overview: It is a momentous day for Michelle's friend, but will a hamster and a toddler ruin her chance of future happiness? Daniel pushes Melody's sympathy a little too far.

videos.title: Action Replay
videos.overview: Following a car accident, a woman suffering from mental distress asks Ronnie to help her sue the boy she hit. Vivien is left shaken after an unexpected visit.

videos.title: Distractions
videos.overview: Vivien clashes with an agency nurse whose apparent incompetence hides something darker. To Archie's delight, Daniel is mortified to get caught out.

videos.title: After Celia
videos.overview: Following the suicide of a student, Julia meets three people struggling with their guilt. While Daniel is the unwilling centre of attention at the Mill, Nick struggles with his own performance.

videos.title: Smokescreen
videos.overview: A woman asks George for help when it appears her partner's smoking is going to ruin her 40th birthday. Michelle regales everyone with details of her date with Mike.

videos.title: The Watcher
videos.overview: When a flirtatious older woman sets her sights on Archie he gets drawn in when he realises she is being followed. Dinner with Caroline and Ed goes badly wrong for Nick.

videos.title: Sins Of The Father
videos.overview: Jimmi helps a politician who is forced to face the truth when his daughter discovers his secret. A school bully of Julia's shows up at the Mill.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: Mike investigates a chemical rash on the scalp of a teenage girl with red hair. Archie and Melody are forced together by unexpected events.

videos.title: Don't Be Afraid Of The Dark
videos.overview: Eva is sent out with a serial killer to find the final body she buried. Vivien makes an announcement.

videos.title: Through The Looking Glass
videos.overview: Mike meets a maths prodigy unable to fit in at university, and angers Michelle when he is late for a date. Everyone struggles with Vivien's announcement.

videos.title: Downsizing
videos.overview: Julia offers the doctors' services in a fitness fair and Melody gets caught in a discussion regarding breast sizes. George has a birthday surprise for Ronnie.

videos.title: A Lesser Man
videos.overview: Jimmi tries to improve the relationship between a bereaved father and his difficult stepdaughter. Julia and Michelle disagree about Mike, who upsets a young girl.

videos.title: Fallout
videos.overview:
George and Ronnie help a mother and her daughter who appears to be caught up in drugs. Ronnie wants to help the girl but both Julia and George just think she needs to be handed over to the police.  Ronnie's belief is justified when the truth comes out.

Nick has a surprise cheerleader at the wheelchair race. Melody has a very constructive assessment meeting with Nick and Michelle and Julia finally agree over Mike.

videos.title: Ben And Norah
videos.overview: A woman worries that the cancer she has been diagnosed with will kill her. Nick and Caroline realise they may have something special after spending the night together.

videos.title: Light Fingers, Loose Tongues
videos.overview: Michelle gets more than she bargained for when she stands up to two shoplifters. Ronnie is shocked to find Eva in unfamiliar territory, and she warns him not to tell Jimmi. Nick promises Caroline a surprise.

videos.title: Walking On Sunshine
videos.overview: Nick is invited to contribute to a 'celebration' of a patient's life but the eulogy he writes is badly misjudged. Bracken's life is put in danger at the Mill. Eva has established herself well in her new world but makes an enemy of Jack's son Callum.

videos.title: Heroes And Villians
videos.overview:
The lorry driver must choose between owning up to his actions and starting a new life with his family - Will he do the right thing?

Meanwhile, the staff at the Mill struggle to keep it together as the young witness of the accident tries to come to terms with what he saw.

videos.title: Under Control
videos.overview:
Melody, still struggling to cope with the tragedy from earlier in the week, helps a working mother who cannot let go of any aspect of her domestic life.

Meanwhile, it is Vivien's first day back at The Mill since her announcement, and Eva's cover at the bar is threatened.

videos.title: Hunger Strike
videos.overview:
A student stages a hunger strike in protest against the University's partnership with a multinational corporation, but the University's treasurer seems determined to bring the stunt to an end.

Meanwhile, the staff at The Mill unite to show Vivien they are thinking of her, and Callum catches Eva and Ronnie in a compromising situation - Will he tell Jack?

videos.title: The Lollipop Man
videos.overview:
Former Doctor Who Sylvester McCoy guest stars as Graham Capelli, an actor who once played the title role in 'The Amazing Lollipop Man', a hit 80s series about a mysterious traveller through time and space. He has been given a second shot at stardom, but is everything as it appears? Mike has to deal with the health worries of his childhood hero.

Elsewhere, the Mill staff attend an unconventional funeral, Mike tries to make amends with Michelle, and Jimmi is concerned over Eva's absence.

videos.title: Wooden Heart
videos.overview:
When Ruth visits a dentist, she ends up dealing with a lot more than toothache - It turns into a counselling session, and she even ends up trying to play Cupid for him!

Meanwhile, Julia interviews an enthusiastic surgeon who wants to move into General Practice - Could he be the new partner at the Mill?

videos.title: Pokerface
videos.overview:
The truth proves elusive when Daniel meets a father and daughter who are even bigger players than he is.

Meanwhile, Eva secretly meets with a stunned Jimmi, who demands to know what's going on, and Viven discovers that she knows Heston of old, and it's not good news.

videos.title: Anger Management
videos.overview:
As Heston faces his first day at The Mill, a bus driver is forced to face his fear of doctors. With Heston's methods proving somewhat unorthodox, has Julia made a terrible decision?

Meanwhile, Poppy is in hot water with Callum, who is demanding more than an apology. Unable to stand by any longer, Eva intervenes, and the result is a struggle which ends in a gunshot... Is this the end for Eva?

videos.title: The Last Time
videos.overview: A panicked Poppy runs to the Mill for help, and Jimmi helps to calm her. Fearing for Eva's safety, he decides to take matters into his own hands, as Jack vows revenge.

videos.title: Don't Try This At Home
videos.overview:
There's a foul stench coming from the water at the campus surgery, and Archie smells a rat - It's not long before the water board SWAT team arrive.

Meanwhile, Eva escapes from the bar with the evidence she needs, hotly pursued by Matt and an enraged Jack. A showdown looms...

videos.title: Brick Teasers
videos.overview:
Ronnie is dragged into a jealous couple's relationship troubles when the woman is convinced her husband is cheating on her. The husband, however, has his own suspicions, leading Ronnie to end the day with a bloody nose and the trauma caused by a red thong to show for his troubles.

Meanwhile, Jimmi is inundated with messages of sympathy from his colleagues at the Mill and the station, but Julia is concerned - Is he hiding his grief?

videos.title: Baby I Love You
videos.overview:
Jimmi is called in when Vivien finds an abandoned baby with a high temperature on her doorstep - When the mother arrives, can she be persuaded to stay?

Meanwhile, Ronnie must resist temptation when a property developer offers him a large sum of money to get his plans passed. Will he do the right thing?

videos.title: Aladdin's Cave
videos.overview:
Melody tries to root out the cause of an old woman's out of control obsession with hoarding, hoping that she can save her from being evicted.

Meanwhile, Jimmi surprises everyone when he returns to work - is it too soon? And Michelle is concerned when she sees Ruth and Mike together on a group outing.

videos.title: Heston C In Da House
videos.overview:
Heston becomes the target of Ruth and Michelle's tomfoolery, with potentially disastrous results for his patients.

Ruth and Michelle later have a girly chat, and Michelle is left with a lot of thinking to do when Ruth reveals some shocking information.

videos.title: Holding Back
videos.overview:
When a lazy, self-dramatising man with angina finds out his wife has cancer, his attempts to help leave a lot to be desired, and George finds herself stepping in.

Mike tries to make some effort with Michelle, while George and Ronnie discuss holiday ideas - but will they agree?

Jimmi and Ronnie have a much needed conversation.

videos.title: Reasons to be Cheerful
videos.overview:
When a lazy, self-dramatising man with angina finds out his wife has cancer, his attempts to help leave a lot to be desired, and George finds herself stepping in.

Mike tries to make some effort with Michelle, while George and Ronnie discuss holiday ideas - but will they agree?

Jimmi and Ronnie have a much needed conversation.

videos.title: Altered States
videos.overview: Daniel finds himself frustrated when a man with a frontal lobe tumour refuses to have the operation which could save his life. Heston calls a meeting with all of the doctors but doesn't quite get the response he's looking for. Ronnie is surprised by George's solution to the holiday problem.

videos.title: Kiss of Death
videos.overview:
Rowena has a recurring nightmare that her fiance is dead, which is compounded when Dave, her fiance, has to visit Lily with chest pains. The whole thing comes to a head when she calls off the wedding, and Lily has to unlock some painful memories in order to help Rowena understand her dreams.

Lily, the new doctor, arrives at the Mill, and Heston is very excited. The rest of the team are intrigued when Jimmi tells them her nickname is Morticia at the police station, and that she is another police surgeon. Heston asks Daniel to move out of his consulting room to accommodate her, and as recompense, the homeless Daniel is invited by Lily to be her lodger.

During a girlie night out, Melody, Michelle and Ruth see Heston inviting a teenager into his car, and immediately think he is a rent boy.

videos.title: Here be Monsters
videos.overview:
It is Halloween, and a young traumatised boy is brought into the police station. He will not speak, and it takes all of Jimmi's skill to help him. He is intrigued by the boy's drawings, and soon realises that they may provide a clue to as to why the boy refuses to speak. He persuades the police that a murder might have taken place, but an overzealous policeman puts the boy's life at risk and Jimmi must save him.

Heston invites everyone to a Halloween party. Everyone is keen to see Heston's house, and when he appears in a Rocky Horror-style outfit, their suspicions that he is gay are confirmed. He tries to chat up Lily to no avail. Daniel, however, chats up Ruth and takes her home.

videos.title: A Spot of Comedy
videos.overview:
It's Comedy Week at the campus and a struggling comedian is doing a spot at the union, so Archie and Ruth go along to see him. Thinking that he is ill, Archie thinks decides to go back to see him, and finds that his wife wants him to grow up so that they can start a family. He is in danger of losing everything, but after speaking to Archie he decides that his wife is more important than comedy.

Meanwhile, Ruth wakes up in Daniel's arms, and Lily sees her as she leaves, much to her embarrassment. When she tells Michelle, she is surprised by her frosty reaction. Heston and Vivien clash over the systems he has implemented, reducing Vivien is reduced to tears. When Michelle explains that Vivien has been having a difficult time, Heston is mortified and sends her home, opting to man the reception himself for the rest of the day.

videos.title: Miss Letherbridge
videos.overview:
Fiona is recovering from a bad accident, and has entered a local beauty contest. Melody is not sure that it is a good idea, and becomes even less sure when she meets her rival Dixie, who is an old hand at such contests. The girls wage war against each other, and Melody is horrified at the lengths they will go to. She then discovers that Ted Drabble, who is organizing the contest, is manipulating both of them.

Julia returns to find Lily is the new doctor and potential partner. Unhappy with Heston, she contacts Ronnie to find out if she has to go along with it, only to discover that she does. Meanwhile, Ruth invites Daniel on another date, but he gives her the brush off, and she is consoled by a sympathetic Michelle.

videos.title: Relinquishment
videos.overview:
Heston has been called to an elderly patient, who is dead when he arrives. He is then forced to referee an argument between the three children as they argue about her last wishes, which were to allow her body to be used for medical research.

Lily, meanwhile, is called to confirm the death of a man found on the edge of a bonfire. An eager policeman wants it to be a suspicious death, but Lily works out that he fell into the bonfire, and that his dog had tried to pull him out.

In the middle of all this, Heston tries to contact Lily to reassure her that he is not gay.

videos.title: Daddy Darling
videos.overview:
An elderly resident dies in a shabby hotel. The proprietor is a philanderer, and when one of his female companions decides that they should marry, his daughter pretends that her father has died, passing off the elderly man as her father. George becomes suspicious when she realises that he had seen Michelle earlier in the day, and together they unmask the deception.

Heston brings Andy, the young boy that he is mentoring, to work. When Melody spends some time with him, she realises that he is suffering from psoriasis, and mentions it to a grateful Heston. Afterwards, Melody asks a delighted Heston if he will be her RCGP supervisor, and he accepts.

Elsewhere, Julia and Lily realise that they will have to get along for the good of the practice.

videos.title: Chill Out
videos.overview: A mother's relationship with her son is jeopardised when she takes an ecstacy tablet, mistaking it for a paracetamol. Meanwhile, Heston takes Andy on an activity day.

videos.title: I Know What You Did Last Semester
videos.overview: Ronnie is called to assist a local MP with a harassment case, and discovers a dark and shady past. Meanwhile, Heston's relationship with Lily starts to flourish, but his excitement is brought down a level when he discovers that his recent mentorship has fallen apart.

videos.title: Safe Haven
videos.overview:
Archie's generous demeanour is shattered and his life put at risk when he helps a woman with agoraphobia.

Meanwhile, Lily confronts Daniel about his lack of housekeeping duties, and takes drastic measures to put him right.

videos.title: Hearts and Minds
videos.overview:
Melody visits a friend undergoing cancer treatment, who fears her secret past will endanger an admirable relationship.

Meanwhile, Vivien returns to the surgery, feeling alone in dealing with her rape trial, and tensions escalate between Lily and Julia, leaving Heston caught in the middle.

videos.title: What's Love Got To Do With It?
videos.overview: Jimmi and Lily find themselves at the heart of a hostage situation, with the future of a doting sister at stake. Meanwhile, Michelle opens up to Ruth about her previous relationships, leaving Ruth happy that Michelle has bared her deepest secrets to her.

videos.title: Trapped in Space
videos.overview:
A patient has to overcome his claustrophobia when he fears that it is ruining his relationship.

Meanwhile, Heston has to apologise to Julia when his lack of experience as a GP could have had dangerous consequences, and Lily and Julia manage to find some common ground.

videos.title: Fragile Minds
videos.overview: Archie and Heston argue over an unstable youth who has taken refuge on the roof of the surgery. Meanwhile, tensions run high as Vivien's rape trial approaches, and Heston tries to interest Julia in the idea of implementing a new drugs trial at the surgery.

videos.title: A Room Full of Strangers
videos.overview: It is the first day of Vivien's rape trial and, dwarfed by the imposing court surroundings, she is left feeling vulnerable. Will she find the composure to stand up and secure a conviction by speaking from the heart?

videos.title: Making An Argument
videos.overview:
Heston shares his drug trial plans with his fellow partners at the surgery, but is is faced with mixed views on the subject, especially when George tracks down a PhD arguing against such plans.

Meanwhile, Vivien fears facing the defence barrister on the second day of her rape trial.

videos.title: The Power of Three
videos.overview:
At the Mill, Lily, Heston and Daniel find themselves tending to three women who have all fallen pregnant by the same man.

Meanwhile, proceedings are coming to a close at Vivien's rape trial. Jimmi is called to the witness stand, unconvinced that his words will have an impact.

videos.title: My Son the Guinea Pig
videos.overview:
Michelle supports the first 'casualties' of the new drugs trial over at the university campus.

Meanwhile, Vivien cautiously awaits the verdict from her rape trial, and is trying to re-organise everything in order to alleviate her agitation.

videos.title: VIP Treatment
videos.overview: An imposing gentleman tries to manipulatively conceal the truth of an accident he caused. Meanwhile at the Mill, Vivien returns to work after her trial, but is not as overjoyed as everyone presumes. This is in stark contrast to Heston, who is busy creating the perfect romantic meal for himself and Lily.

videos.title: The Milky Way
videos.overview: George helps two women fight for mothers' rights when she discovers that traditionalist views are not always the best policy. Melody finally confronts Archie to settle their rocky friendship, and Michelle is in desperate need of a much deserved holiday.

videos.title: A Second Chance
videos.overview: Melody finds herself helping a family come to terms with depression, and discovers a dark secret that the family has been harbouring for 16 years. Vivien, meanwhile, is on edge as she awaits the final sentencing for the two boys that raped her.

videos.title: From the Ashes
videos.overview: Vivien becomes entangled in a bitter feud as she awaits news from Ronnie about the final sentencing of the rape trial. Meanwhile, Archie deals with a ditzy temp who is covering for Ruth while she is away on holiday with Michelle.

videos.title: Buried
videos.overview: After a shocking discovery is made in an old house, Lily helps a woman who is trapped by her past. Melody anxiously over-prepares for her RCGP accreditation meeting with Heston, while Archie has a date with his new love interest.

videos.title: Changes
videos.overview:
Heston treats a previously unpleasant man who appears to have undergone a complete personality change following a heart transplant.

Melody, meanwhile, does her best to keep things friendly as she absorbs the news about Archie's newfound relationship with Kirsten.

videos.title: The Visit
videos.overview:
Jimmi is almost duped by an elderly con artist and thief when he mistakes her for the mother of a patient.

Archie's relationship with Kirsten begins to bloom when he opens up about his past, while a suggestion from an unknown work colleague gives Heston an opportunity to get closer to Lily.

videos.title: Do the Right Thing
videos.overview:
Lily encounters a young boy from Africa with a high temperature and cough, and her suspicious are aroused when his mother is reluctant to let him have a blood test. Heston tries to make amends with Lily after falling asleep at the previous night's lecture.

Meanwhile, Vivien has her first professional driving lesson, and thinks that her instructor is marvellous.

videos.title: Sandra's Grotto
videos.overview:
George diagnoses a small child with a virus, but her mother becomes hysterical when she spies a rat in their neighbour's garden.

Meanwhile, Heston steps up his efforts to win Lily over, but becomes entwined with an angry patient.

videos.title: Head Case
videos.overview:
When a husband brings his wife to Daniel, he is worried about her meandering ways, but Daniel uncovers a more complicated problem related to a car crash.

Meanwhile, George makes a startling discovery after she realises that she vaguely recognises Archie's new flame.

videos.title: Pink Ribbon
videos.overview:
Julia is involved in arranging a party for a friend who has beaten cancer, but she is distrustful of her husband, who has been a philanderer in the past, and is concerned for her friend's future.

Archie confronts Kirsten about her involvement in the demonstrations against the "Tralawney Wells" drug trials.

Ruth and Michelle are back from their winter holiday, but their relaxed demeanour is soon quashed when Michelle reveals a shocking discovery about Ruth.

videos.title: The Perfect Couple
videos.overview:
Melody helps an active woman come to terms with her eating disorder to allow her to become pregnant.

Michelle consoles Ruth when she decides to confront Daniel about her pregnancy, but it does not go as smoothly as they both planned.

Vivien has her last driving lesson before her test, and she is literally firing on all cylinders!

videos.title: Testing Times
videos.overview:
Kirsten decisively reveals to Archie the real reason why she demonstrated against the drug trials that have been taking place.

Daniel fights to resolve matters with Ruth and her suspected pregnancy, while Michelle tries to comfort her.

Vivien takes her driving test, and her confidence is at an all-time low.

videos.title: Just Deserts
videos.overview:
A pensioner realises that things are not always as straightforward as they seem when she is confronted by the asylum seeker she is trying to oust.

Kirsten tries to get Archie more involved in bringing down the drug trials, landing him in deep water.

videos.title: The Cuckold King
videos.overview:
Blaming himself for his impotence, a timid man allows his wife to humiliate him.

Meanwhile, Archie has his first real row with Kirsten, and Daniel is suffering with a hangover after celebrating his news that Ruth is not pregnant.

videos.title: Minuit
videos.overview: Ruth tends to a student who will stop at nothing in his attempts to get to know a beautiful French girl. Meanwhile, Julia is covering reception, but is taken aback when she discovers a baby that has been deserted by its mother.

videos.title: The Honeytrap
videos.overview:
An old friend of Julia's wants to involve her in an outrageous plan to find out if her potential fiance can be trusted.

Meanwhile, Daniel takes baby Isobel home, and is left with the unenviable task of asking Lily if she minds her staying the night!

videos.title: Daylight Robbery
videos.overview:
Archie intervenes when he suspects an elderly patient is being targeted by an unscrupulous double glazing salesman.

Meanwhile, Daniel brings Isobel to the surgery and attempts to track down her mother.

videos.title: The Break Out
videos.overview:
Heston's visit to a retirement home proves to be a more eventful day that he was expecting!

Daniel digs deeper to try and find the mother of baby Isobel but fatherhood might be becoming something that he is getting used to!

videos.title: Naughty or Nice
videos.overview:
It is the last day of work before the Christmas break, and Heston has arranged a Christmas party for the team.

Daniel tries to arrange care for baby Isobel so he can continue his festivities in Greece, while Archie tracks Kirsten down and uncovers her plans to bring down the drugs trials.

videos.title: Forgive Us Our Sins
videos.overview:
Jimmi finds himself trapped in the flat of an emphysema-stricken female paedophile.

Daniel, meanwhile, desperately tries to arrange childcare for Isobel, and the solution turns out to be much closer to home than he was expecting.

videos.title: My Other Life
videos.overview:
Michelle tends to the baby of a single mum and discovers that she has had enough of living a life of lies.

Meanwhile, Archie has a shock with Layla Darwish visits Heston to talk about the lab break-in, and Daniel continues his quest to find childcare for Isobel.

videos.title: Little By Little
videos.overview:
Julia finds herself on a quest to save a couple's marriage when she attends a friend's retirement dinner, while Heston bites off more than he can chew as he prepares for his date with Lily.

Daniel, meanwhile, eagerly awaits baby Isobel's paternity test results.

videos.title: A Bit of What You Fancy
videos.overview:
A middle-aged woman on the heels of a messy divorce is going through a hedonist phase, much to the dismay of her teenage daughter, who craves some stability.

Daniel employs an au pair to look after baby Isobel, and Heston tries to smooth things over with Lily after their disastrous dinner.

videos.title: Schlock, Stock and Two Smoking Harolds
videos.overview:
George observes a couple who are desperately trying to give up smoking, but discovers that there are larger obstacles for them to overcome.

Meanwhile, Daniel is left with the task of sacking his au pair, and Heston calls for an emergency meeting about the drugs trials.

videos.title: Cry Wolf
videos.overview:
News of a recent attack published in the local paper pushes a mother to take action against her own flesh and blood.

Meanwhile, Heston is still in a foul mood over his disastrous evening with Lily which Layla gatecrashed, and Archie tracks down Kirsten to discuss the poison pen letters that Layla has received.

videos.title: Facing the Music
videos.overview:
A talented young pianist rebels against his parent's requests and takes on private tuition which later leaves him in a scale of trouble!

Meanwhile, Archie conjures up the courage to break into the Trelawney Wells laboratory with Kirsten, in broad daylight!

videos.title: Widow-To-Be
videos.overview:
Julia meets a patient who wants to declare her missing husband dead. She is put in a tricky position, however, when she discovers that he is still alive.

Meanwhile, Vivien stops a vicar's daughter from running away from home.

videos.title: Wandering Off
videos.overview:
Melody tends to a single mother with a growing self-doubt, and witnesses her desperation for stability and order in her life.

Meanwhile, an unexpected arrival brings Daniel's childcare problems to an end, and Archie struggles with his fear of how to expose the truth about the Trelawney Wells drug trials.

videos.title: Tigger and the Gold Digger
videos.overview:
Michelle catches up with an old school friend who has become the gold-digging trophy girlfriend of a best-selling author, and proud of it!

Daniel faces up to his overbearing mother, who is caring for Izzie.

Kirsten returns to Archie after spending a night in the cells for being caught breaking into a lab facility.

videos.title: Altered Ego
videos.overview:
A bright first-generation student is torn between her background and her future when her boyfriend from home pays her a visit.

Meanwhile, Ruth's low demeanor prompts Michelle to cheer her up, and Archie faces his nemesis once again when he tries to expose the truth about the drugs trials.

videos.title: You People
videos.overview:
Archie gets embroiled in an argument about who should be occupying a ground floor flat.

Elsewhere, Julia and Heston discuss Archie's future after he exposed the truth about the drugs trials, and Michelle makes it up to Ruth for forgetting her birthday.

videos.title: Arranged Family
videos.overview:
Michelle gets suspicious when a Russian girl says she is pregnant by an older patient of hers.

It is Bracken's first day at school and Ronnie is nervous for her, while Melody prepares for her first date with Milo, her childhood crush.

videos.title: We'll Meet Again
videos.overview:
Vivien is on a day out, but an old man hijacks her car, and she has to take him to find his lost love.

Elsewhere, Melody awakes from sleeping over at Milo's house, and arrives at the Mill in the previous night's clothes.

And Ronnie is still anxious about Bracken not settling in at nursery, but George tries to put his mind at rest.

videos.title: Don't Say a Word
videos.overview:
Jimmi treats a patient at the police station, and is shocked to discover that the arrival of his new baby has pushed him to take extreme measures.

Meanwhile, Melody has lunch with her older brother, Felix, and he reveals a softer side, despite a rocky start. Felix also has some news that prompts Melody to visit Milo, a decision which has alarming consequences.

videos.title: The Old-Fashioned Way
videos.overview:
Heston gives an old-fashioned watchmaker a wake-up call, which helps him realise he does not have to risk everything to get what he wants.

Elsewhere, Melody is still very shaken by her encounter with Milo, but resists Michelle's pleas to call the police, while Milo fastidiously prepares his car for a special journey with his children.

videos.title: Moments in the Sun
videos.overview:
A chance encounter on the phone raises Ruth's spirits, and she lets herself be drawn into a romantic fantasy, never realising the sad truth that lies behind it.

Meanwhile, a chat with Jimmi fuels Melody's suspicions about Milo, but can she convince Michelle to help her find him before it is too late?

videos.title: Tears of a Clown
videos.overview:
Ronnie gets roped into helping at a children's party, and gets more than he bargained for when the children's entertainer comes face to face with his past.

Meanwhile, Julia is surprised by Heston's enthusiasm for the staff appraisals, and Daniel is shocked to find a surprise visitor on his doorstep.

videos.title: Voice Control
videos.overview:
Vivien's vanity lands her in the middle of two con artists and their elaborate scheme to cheat a relative out of some money.

Meanwhile, Lily and Heston's appraisal does not turn out the way Heston had hoped, and Lisa has some news that leaves Daniel distraught.

videos.title: Love Will Find a Way
videos.overview:
Michelle spots an opportunity to play Cupid when she helps a girl find her long-lost fiance.

Daniel tries to carry on as normal, but missing Izzy finally gets to him.

Jimmi's behaviour on Eva's birthday leaves Julia and George feeling bemused.

videos.title: The End of the World
videos.overview:
An elderly lady lives in terror of imminent apocalypse, and Heston goes to extreme lengths to get her to face up to what the real problem is.

Ruth is being uncharacteristically kind to Daniel, but when he throws her efforts back in her face, she snaps at him. Her words spur Daniel to try to make contact with Lisa, but he does not get the answer he hoped for.

Despite Ronnie's misgivings, Julia and George conspire to get Jimmi to open up about Eva, and invite him to dinner at Julia's, but his revelation leaves them reeling.

videos.title: Wanted
videos.overview:
Jimmi and Lily work with Eva's replacement, DI Banks, on a rape case where a young girl must risk blowing her family apart in order to get justice.

Meanwhile, Daniel is missing Izzie, so he decides to try and find her himself.

George realises how difficult it was for Ronnie to keep Jimmi's secret, and Julia goes to apologise to Jimmi, who reveals how desperately sad he is that he will never see Eva again.

videos.title: Vantage Point
videos.overview:
Daniel lies to help a man desperate to see his son, but can he do the right thing before his intervention makes a bad situation even worse?

Ruth is delighted when Michelle pays her a compliment, while Vivien gets a fright when she is reminded of her attack, and she finds a friend in Lily.

videos.title: Dear Diary
videos.overview:
A schoolboy tells George that he has whiplash from crashing the headteacher's car into his school, and he wants to sue!

Meanwhile, Vivien starts writing in her diary, but it becomes clear that her true feelings are not being expressed on the page at all.

And Daniel gets to spend some time with Izzie.

videos.title: Silently Screaming
videos.overview:
Secrets are shared and fears are revealed when Vivien and Lily find themselves working late at the surgery.

Vivien is haunted by memories of her rape ordeal, but as Lily tries to help her move on, she is forced to confront some demons of her own.

videos.title: Tempt Not a Desperate Man
videos.overview:
The beginning of Aftershock Week.

Daniel is called to the Junction Estate to see a patient who has a surprising intruder, and he makes a horrifying discovery.

Meanwhile, Julia is surprised to see an old friend taking an unexpected job, and Ruth is swept off her feet when she helps a handsome young university cleaner.

videos.title: Violent Delights Have Violent Ends
videos.overview:
As the estate comes to terms with the killing, Heston helps a young teaching assistant through a crisis of confidence, and together they try to help one of the child gang members.

Ruth is concerned when Lenny fails to show up for work, and soon finds herself getting sucked into his world.

videos.title: O True Apothecary
videos.overview:
As the community draws closer together, an elderly woman's daughter tries to get her mother to move in with her. She is reluctant to go, until she discovers something shocking.

Meanwhile, Michelle's excitement to meet Lenny is short-lived, as Ruth herself starts to have doubts about him.

videos.title: A Plague on Both Your Houses
videos.overview:
Dorothy finally finds her feet when she is teamed up with a streetwise and ambitious PC, but enlists Jimmi's help when one of the gang members is arrested and all is not as it seems.

Meanwhile, Ruth and Lenny become closer, but will it last?

videos.title: Sweet Good Night
videos.overview:
The story behind the stabbing is revealed when Dorothy finds a teenage girl in shock and takes her to the surgery to see Melody.

Also, Ruth makes her final decision, while Dorothy talks to Julia about her future.

videos.title: Defining Happy
videos.overview:
George helps a young girl who is literally worrying herself sick that her family is being torn apart.

Melody and Michelle's spooky suggestion to cheer up Ruth has a serious effect on her mental health, and George fears that she has left it too late to have another child.

videos.title: Baby Bliss
videos.overview:
Melody and an emasculated stay-at-home dad answer a bizarre call for help, which turns him from slob to action man.

Meanwhile, Ruth feels energised when she goes to the aid of a collapsed man, and an overheard conversation threatens Daniel's future with Izzie, as it prompts an angry Ruth to reveal his past to Lisa.

videos.title: Amends
videos.overview:
When Daniel is called to attend to an asthmatic bride on her wedding day, he soon finds himself embroiled in a tense family reunion.

Meanwhile, Jimmi tries to keep his personal feelings under control when he meets a father who is struggling to cope.

videos.title: First Love Last Love
videos.overview:
Ronnie helps two childhood sweethearts, who have rekindled their romance after fifty years apart, when a shocking secret comes to light.

Ruth is devastated when Michelle asks for some time alone.

And Daniel is confused and angry when Lisa tells him he will not be seeing Izzie any time soon, while George plans an evening of seduction for Ronnie.

videos.title: Towards the Light
videos.overview:
Heston's excitement at an unusual case blinds him to how his patient is really feeling.

Things are a bit awkward between Michelle and Ruth, and Vivien encourages Ruth to enrol in some kind of evening class as a way to meet new people.

And George surprises Ronnie with an unusual gift to help them conceive, causing them to argue over baby names...

videos.title: Mac's Women
videos.overview:
Julia has to eat humble pie when she believes a woman's accusations about Mac, while Karen, the new temp at the Mill, fails to meet Vivien's exacting standards.

Archie returns from his trip overseas worried that life at the Mill will not measure up, and Ruth's initial anxiety about her first art class vanishes when she meets the hunky teacher.

videos.title: Click - Part 1
videos.overview:
A teenage boy who is being cyber-bullied attempts to kill himself, prompting Melody to investigate further.

Elsewhere, a new enthusiasm for a social networking site backfires for Ruth, who is plagued by an unwanted face from the past.

videos.title: Click - Part 2
videos.overview: With time running out for the cyberbully, Melody must find the truth and stop tensions from escalating to boiling point. And can Ruth finally face up to Diane?

videos.title: Limbo
videos.overview:
Jimmi realises how lonely he is when he helps a woman and her son who are on the run from an abusive marriage.

And Vivien's day goes from bad to worse when first a virus causes havoc with her email, and then Karen returns, contrary to Vivien's instructions. But by the day's end, Vivien grudgingly admits that she is impressed with the temp.

videos.title: Fly by Night
videos.overview:
Michelle is forced to lie for her friend, who is cheating on her partner.

Meanwhile Ruth, left to hold the fort at the campus surgery, tries on Michelle's uniform. But when an unexpected patient puts her on the spot, Ruth introduces herself as Nurse Corrigan!

videos.title: Dem Bones
videos.overview:
A glimpse into the past reveals the people who changed Lily's life, and explains her attachment to the skull.

Heston meets an old friend from medical school and is gobsmacked when this friend reveals a connection to someone at the Mill.

Ruth thinks like Michelle and makes a daring move during art class.

videos.title: Old Haunts
videos.overview:
A traffic offence and a DNA test open up a can of worms for Ronnie and his client.

Lionel's revelation makes Heston see Vivien in a new light, and he regrets the promise he made him.

And Ruth blows Adam away with a new dress and some stolen answers.

videos.title: Window
videos.overview:
Ruth gets caught up in a waitress' struggle to deal with her seemingly oppressive relationship as she dreams of a better life.

Meanwhile, George's desire for a new baby comes close to being an obsession, and Lily puts paid to Heston's attempt to play Cupid.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview:
Archie helps two young teenagers whose plans to escape to a better life almost prove fatal, while Daniel struggles to gain access to Izzie as Lisa starts to use his own past against him.

And as she tries to help Vivien, Lily realises that maybe she should take her own advice and give love a chance.

videos.title: Little White Lies
videos.overview: Daniel steps in to help a stressed patient whose addictive secret is causing marital difficulties. Meanwhile, change is on the cards for George and Ronnie, and Lily tries her hand at matchmaking.

videos.title: The Two Leo Beckfords
videos.overview:
Vivien wages a one-woman war on a two-faced tearaway, while Lily and Heston seem to be moving further apart as they argue in the surgery.

And, having predicted the patter of tiny feet, Julia is shocked by George's actual announcement.

videos.title: Road to Recovery
videos.overview:
Lily gets caught up with a hypochondriac, and a trip to the hospital puts both of their lives in danger.

Meanwhile, Ruth is still cagey about her new man, and George and Ronnie break their big news to the team.

Heston fails to unite Vivien and Lionel, but finally manages to ignite Lily's affections in the process.

videos.title: A Life in Pictures
videos.overview:
Jimmi reluctantly gets involved in a student film, and ends up helping the director see that the bad news he receives should not thwart his romantic intentions.

Heston struggles to comply with Lily's wish that their romance be kept a secret, while Vivien is adamant that her relationship with Lionel should stay firmly in the past.

And when George and Ronnie try to tell Bracken about the move to China, they wonder if they are doing the right thing.

videos.title: FlimFlam Thank You Man
videos.overview:
Archie's adherence to the rule of patient confidentiality is stretched to the limit when dealing with a game-playing student who is out to get revenge.

Meanwhile, Heston and Lily accidentally start arranging a leaving party for George, Vivien continues to deliberate about seeing Lionel, and Daniel wonders who betrayed his shady past to Lisa.

videos.title: The Thirteenth
videos.overview:
Michelle treats a seemingly harmless patient who claims to see fairies at the bottom of his garden.

Heston struggles to enter into the spirit of Lily's romantic camping trip, but ends up getting more than he could have hoped for.

Ruth and Adam's relationship becomes more intimate.

videos.title: Skin Deep
videos.overview:
After an initial run-in, Julia helps a distressed teenage gypsy plagued by a skin problem.

Heston tries to persuade Julia to help with his matchmaking plans, and Michelle is eager to hear all the juicy details from Ruth's date.

videos.title: Heal Thyself
videos.overview: Melody fears she has missed something important when diagnosing a patient. Can she make it to him in time? Meanwhile, Vivien finally takes the plunge and phones Lionel.

videos.title: Cows
videos.overview:
George and Ronnie journey to the countryside to help a burly farmer resolve a difficult family dynamic.

Ruth is upset when Michelle mocks her handmade gift and Daniel accuses her of airing his dirty laundry.

Vivien continues to agonise over Lionel's invitation to join him in Bermuda.

videos.title: Over the Cracks
videos.overview:
Heston gets caught up in a young couple's decorating feud with their grandmother, and discovers a lot more than anyone expected.

Ruth is as reluctant to let Michelle meet her new man as he is keen to meet her friends, and when Vivien fails to turn up for work, a concerned Jimmi goes to see her, hoping to help.

videos.title: Past Imperfect
videos.overview:
Archie is accused of kidnapping when an elderly woman does a runner from the care home her son is sending her to, but where has she gone, and why?

Ruth is looking forward to a girly night out, but is unprepared for an extra guest. Everyone is perturbed by some unusual behaviour from Vivien, until the cause is revealed.

videos.title: Hillgate J-91 - Part 1
videos.overview:
When Julia receives some anonymous mail warning her to be wary of a handsome new neighbour, she finds herself embroiled in a dangerous hate campaign, and becomes a target for animal rights extremists.

Meanwhile, Karen is thrown into a quandary when she receives an offer from Julia, and George has some surprising news for Ronnie which changes everything.

videos.title: Hillgate J-91 - Part 2
videos.overview:
The campaign intensifies and, while the police try to catch the culprits, Janet tries to help her daughter see sense.

Meanwhile, Archie finds himself on the receiving end of Julia's wrath, and Heston is dismayed when he receives some news about his party.

George makes her position very clear to Ronnie, and they both struggle to come to terms with the change.

videos.title: Keep it in the Family
videos.overview: Melody aids a father and son who are struggling to communicate at a time of crisis, and Daniel helps a young mother struggling with alcohol addiction to make the right choice and put her son first.

videos.title: Love, Labour, Lust
videos.overview:
An aging once-famous actor, famed for throwing tantrums and leching after young actresses, finds himself a new target, much to the upset and disgust of all around him.

Things go from bad to worse when George's mother arrives to say goodbye, and Daniel is delighted when Lisa pays him a surprise visit.

videos.title: The Right Time
videos.overview:
Michelle helps a jazz trumpeter face a harsh reality about his future.

Meanwhile, George and Ronnie finally make a decision about whether to go to China, and Ruth finds her world unravelling as Daniel determines to track her down, with unexpected consequences.

videos.title: Love Letters Straight From the Heart
Bed Hopping Mad
videos.overview:
Melody's day takes a turn for the farcical when she becomes embroiled in a love triangle between three students.

And Jimmi's attempts to save Melody from the wrath of Julia are scuppered when he gets stuck in an impossible situation.

videos.title: But For the Grace of God
The People at the Top of the Stairs
In The Cold Hard Light of Day
Fifteen Minutes
videos.overview: A man arrested for possessing indecent images of children is talked into hanging himself by one of the cops on duty. Karen tries on a rubber outfit to try and spice up her marriage, much to Zara's amusement. A devious Michelle gets Jimmi his radio job back, but doesn't tell him.

videos.title: Volte Face
videos.overview: Rob breaks down a house door to discover a young boy has stabbed a man inside. Lily gives a hand, but with terrible consequences. Zara has the chance of a free holiday to Africa with a hot married man. Karen finds a pair of woman's sexy red knickers in Jack's room.

videos.title: The Good Cowboy
videos.overview: Rob meets up with a man who says he gets messages from car number plates. Karen goes to see Jack at university, much to Jack's horror. Karen struggles with her emotions after Jack's departure to university, while Daniel and Jimmi see a gorgeous girl, Chloe, at the Icon Bar, and end up competing for her affections.

videos.title: Nobody
videos.overview: Jimmi goes to a funeral, and bumps into a tramp who says he knows the deceased. Heston's ex-wife turns up at his house, much to his and Lily's surprise.

videos.title: Love Knot
videos.overview: Hot Zara returns from a sexual indiscretion with a married 'Afrikana Hunk', and is called out to a house call at a farm in the middle of nowhere. Trouble is afoot though.

videos.title: The Romantics
videos.overview: Cherry deals with an old romantic and a love triangle. Both she and Heston have big decisions to make.

videos.title: Reverberation
videos.overview: Julia is shocked when a woman who has chlamydia, turns up at her friend's husbands funeral. Heston starts to have doubts that Christine may have been using him all along.

videos.title: Family Values
videos.overview: Jack tells his parents about him losing his term's money on a bet. Simon ruins a racist's day - a party member of the British Pride Party. Jimmi gets a 'Golden Microphone' nomination for his radio show. Scott saves Cherry from a mugging, or did he plan it all?

videos.title: Worst Critic
videos.overview: Jimmi's patient is stuck in the past, and thinks it's the time of the Suez Canal Crisis. An elderly art teacher gets her revenge on an obnoxious art critic, with Michelle's help.

videos.title: Growing Pains
videos.overview: Immie pretends to live in the past to try and please her dad, by being the perfect daughter. She cooks and everything. Michelle helps an asthmatic teenage girl, whose attention seeking behavior is rather annoying. Jimmi gets a tie in the post.

videos.title: Perspective
videos.overview: Immie's college art exhibition goes awry and annoys her parents when she meets a former burlesque artist and ends up taking most of her clothes off. The Christmas tree competition gets serious, though Michelle is rubbish at it.

videos.title: A Little of What You Fancy
Dance to Keep from Crying
videos.overview: Michelle's mum has had a pain, and the hospital has seen a 'shadow'. So she goes to see Michelle. Julia, still worried about Jimmi's lack of appearance, goes to Rob for help. Jimmi meanwhile, is still chained to a bed post, being force-fed bacon sandwiches and drugs. Sissy introduces him to Veronica and Victoria.

videos.title: Hairy Potter and The Disorderly Felix
Mixed Doubles
videos.overview: Jimmi is still tied up. Sissy, dressed like 'Baby Jane', kisses him all the time, but Jimmi scares her off by shouting 'sex' at her. Julia keeps trying to convince the others that something is not quite right. Sexy Gloria keeps teasing her boyfriend, and has an appointment with Dr Daniel. She wants the pill.

videos.title: Divide and Conquer
videos.overview: Still kept captive by the Juggins, Jimmi tries to wrestle back some control. Rob realises what a mountain he has to climb to find the missing doctor

videos.title: Letting Go
videos.overview: Jimmi finds himself in a hospital bed, safe and sound from the crazy Juggins', who get sectioned. Julia has to fend off a pushy journalist. Charlie tries to help a woman who can't cry.

videos.title: Master Of The Universe - Monday
videos.overview: Jack's university friend Lewis is a troubled boy. His essays at univ are always violent, he keeps having flashbacks to a young schoolgirl he knew, and he is obsessed with video games, especially one called Trigger King. His lecturer is worried about him, and tells Simon, but he moves into the Hollins house for a while. Immie gets scared though when he knows all the victims on her 'victims of gun crime' montage. Some of the doctors are preparing for the university Founders Ball.

videos.title: Master Of The Universe - Tuesday
videos.overview: Lewis is staying at the Hollins house, and he's getting weirder. Ellie can't get his mum's ring off her finger, and it's getting red, so Lewis threatens to cut her finger off, and Jack has a go at her too. Ellie tells Sia, so she confronts Lewis. Sia also gives him rotten marks for his course work, and says his book is violent rubbish. Both Ellie and Sia go to Simon, who is starting to get concerned. Rob sees his inspector about a possible promotion, and is told he's no chance.

videos.title: Master of the Universe: Wednesday
videos.overview: Sia recovers from the fire at the university. She is convinced Lewis set it off. Simon believes her, but no-one else does. Lewis and Jack organize a boycott of all her lessons. Sia confronts Lewis, who admits to her that he did it, and she deserved it. He shows her his gun video, and makes her really scared. Still the police wont act though.

videos.title: Master of the Universe: Thursday - Judgement Day
videos.overview: Lewis freaks Immie out, but still no one will believe her. He finally flips though when he gets Jack, Sia, Ellie and Ned to the university under false pretenses. Karen goes to find Jack after finally being convinced by Immie, and finds herself in the middle of it all, when Lewis storms in brandishing a big gun. A shot rings out.

videos.title: Master of the Universe
videos.overview: Lewis holds the hostages at gunpoint. Simon and the police storm in after the shooting, and it all gets rather heated. Simon tries to keep Sia alive, and the Ball gets ruined, but will Lewis shoot anyone else? Immie burns her art project.

videos.title: Coming To Get You
videos.overview: Harvey can't drink from the water tap, is scared of the phone, and is seeing little gray men. Lily thinks his medication is being messed with. Cherry, Ruth and Michelle decide to give Charlie what they think he wants, namely them. He gets scared. Immie starts dressing completely differently, to get down with her culture...now that she's a lesbian. Jimmi's OCD seems to have gone away, since the kidnapping.

videos.title: The Long and Short of It
No Distance Left to Run
videos.overview: Zara has an uncomfortable first meeting with Matthew's mum, Judith, who is over from Hong Kong. She has the oddest feeling that they have met before. She makes an appointment with Daniel at the surgery, and gives Zara a warning. Charlie directs his charming manner to a woman who finds out her son has been taking her HRT tablets because he wants to become a transsexual.

videos.title: Angel
videos.overview: A dying potter and her young student find a box from 21 years ago, unfortunately the artist smashes what's inside it. Her student deliberately cuts herself with the shards while trying to find out why she stopped making things. Then Rob turns up. Zara calls in her favor from Daniel when she asks him to seduce Matthew's mom Judith. Charlie takes Heston to a Viking themed lap dancing club.

videos.title: The Others
videos.overview: Simon gets caught between two of his best mates, soon to be married. Only he's having an affair with her Maid of Honor, who also happens to be his adopted sister. Daniel has a lunchtime kissing session with Judith, and Zara's in the bushes taking photos. Matthew then proposes to her.

videos.title: Unmoved
videos.overview: Jack goes for a round of job interviews, lies on his application form, but manages to get a job. There's a sexy girl there whom he starts fancying. It's all a bit too much for him though. Lily goes and has a chat with Sapphire, and wonders if Immie will help her get down with the kids, or 'female youth culture'.

videos.title: 6 Underground
videos.overview: Daniel's patient tells him that his girlfriend is missing - she went to the shops and never came back. He has panic attacks. All is not what it seems though, as she is nearer than everyone thinks. Cherry wants to drag Simon to a gay roller camp, only he doesn't want to go. They argue. Lily meets up with Sapphire, hoping to impress her with her new found Emo knowledge.

videos.title: Climb Every Mountain
videos.overview: Michelle deals with a depressed amputee soldier. She makes him climb the local mountain to cheer him up. At lunch, Matthew finally introduces Zara to his dad, Ian, much to Ian's horror. Simon really likes Will's ambulance, so he asks him out on a date.

videos.title: Hell Hath No Fury
videos.overview: Zara puts on her finest stockings, and reddest lipstick to knock 'em dead at the business launch. Her plan to ruin Ian's life is nearing completion, but how far will she go? It's the day of Charlie's charity car wash, but people start getting dubious when it seems he only wants the girls to take part, and asks them to wear tight t-shirts.

videos.title: Birth Of The Blues
videos.overview: Daniel goes round to see Zara, who has called in sick following the events of last week. She shows him the recording she made of Ian's confession. Jimmi helps an aging pop star, who has a bad throat and a pregnant wife. He wants to kick-start his career again. Sapphire finally moves in with Lily. Heston doesn't want to know. Zara dumps Matthew, tears all round.

videos.title: Occupational Hazards
videos.overview: A famous and beautiful woman, who is the head of a natural skincare company goes to the Granger Clinic to have some work done. Unfortunately a nosy journalist tries to get all the medical info out of Ruth. Charlie gets called out to visit a sexy blonde, though when he arrives he finds her on her back, dressed in fishnet stockings and a Basque.

videos.title: Fear of the Dark: Part One
Fear of the Dark: Part Two
videos.overview: Karen spends the night in prison, after the discovery of the dead stranger in the boot of her car. She is questioned for ages. The fake lo-cum who murdered him is still going around pretending to be the murder victim. Lily and Simon delve into who got Sapphire hooked on drugs.

videos.title: Last Cut
videos.overview: One of Simon's patients has decided to spend his time fishing, instead of taking his cancer medication. Charlie announces that he hopes everyone will perform a tap dance for a charity show. They are all reticent, until Charlie shows them all how to do it - he can really tap!

videos.title: Save The Children
videos.overview: Lily gets called in to help Rob deal with two young scumbags. They admit to having raped a missing young girl. And there may be more than one. Sapphire spends the day with Immie and Jack, only Karen isn't too happy, especially when Sapphire chats up Jack. Ruth gets a shock when Smithy mentions children.

videos.title: Mother's Help
videos.overview: Charlie has a severe case of gout, so has to drop out of the tap auditions. It all looks like a disaster when Lily steps in to take the lead. Luckily she is a brilliant dancer. Sapphire is impressed by this and decides she would like to stay with her, so Lily announces she wants to take some time off, so leaves to take care of Sapphire. She has Chromes disease. Diana thinks her nanny is having an affair with her husband and wants to take her baby. Zara gets involved, it could be a case of post-natal psychosis.

videos.title: Catching
videos.overview: Luke is struggling to find a sitter for his daughter while he has an interview for a job. Michelle tries to help, but is shocked by Luke's desperate behavior. Simon and Will have the perfect date. However, is Will too good to be true?

videos.title: Happy Ending
videos.overview: A patient of Daniels wants to die at home, rather than at hospital, so Cherry goes to visit him. He doesn't want his family there, which Cherry finds hard to understand. Daniel also tries to find out from Julia and Heston what's happening with the practice, now that they are a partner down. Smithy has a little surprise for Ruth, he's got a baby from somewhere. He thinks it's theirs, but Ruth is totally shocked. Has Smithy lost his marbles again?

videos.title: One More Scrum
videos.overview: A former rugby player, whose now in a wheelchair, gets into a fight when drunk with mates at a lap dancing club. He injures himself. His put upon wife gets Heston involved. His wife, it seems, is keeping a secret: She's a lap dancer. There're more tap dancing rehearsals, Ruth is really good, though her rehearsal is interrupted when Smithy turns up. He's been tap dancing in the snow, with no shoes on.

videos.title: Mirror
videos.overview:
Rob struggles to work out the cause of a car accident when the only witness seems like a timewaster, but Jimmi digs deeper and finds the witness has a rare condition which could save the driver's life.

Ruth confronts Smithy about his recent behaviour, and Simon fears Will is going off him.

videos.title: Home to Roost
videos.overview: As Smithy's erratic behaviour pushes Ruth to the edge, she has to struggle with a big decision; does she call for help or let Smithy finally be free? Cherry's cynicism provokes Simon to give Will an ultimatum.

videos.title: Neighbourhood Watch
videos.overview: Zara and Daniel argue over the well-being of a meddling OAP, whose stress levels rise as he tries to incriminate his drug-dealing neighbour. Henry tries to help Ruth come to terms with Smithy's sectioning, but Ruth has some big questions about her future.

videos.title: Mystery Tour
videos.overview: Michelle intervenes when the parents of a missing teenager are led on a mystery tour around Letherbridge. Simon has the day from hell, while Julia takes action against Daniel and Zara.

videos.title: Love Me, Hate Me
videos.overview: Charlie and Heston go for a late night Balti, and end up causing some racially aggravated fuss. Jimmi goes to a late night home visit. The woman and her daughter are both fans of his from his radio show, which brings back memories of his recent kidnapping by his 'number one fan'.

videos.title: Synergy
videos.overview: Daniel and Zara are on their very worst behaviour at a team building course. Karen makes a depressing financial realisation, while Simon's birthday party doesn't go to plan.

videos.title: Two's Company
videos.overview: It's the second day of Zara and Daniel's Team Building course, and there's a new leader, Julian having taken the day off for 'personal time'. Zara's in a mood over Daniel's night time exploits with Daisy. The day ends with it all getting a bit serious. Heston meets the IT guy, who turns out to be sexy Susan. He gets drawn in to her personal activities. Simon is worried about Will's strange behavior last night, when he disappeared from his birthday party.

videos.title: Digging for Gold
videos.overview: A friend of Imogen's gets more than she bargained for when she makes a play for a rich elderly man. Karen is shocked to find out what everyone else earns, and Julia is put in a difficult position regarding the partnership.

videos.title: Best Laid Plans
videos.overview: Ruth's day is turned upside town by a tearaway visitor to the Mill. Simon and Will spend a romantic day together while Zara's father is released from prison.

videos.title: Guilty
videos.overview: An attractive female patient of Daniel's has been telling her mate all about their night of passion. It seems she's besotted with him, and turn's up at the Mill, but is she telling the truth? Simon discovers that Will is married with a kid. Karen and Rob argue about money.

videos.title: Protection
videos.overview: Cherry unpicks the secrets and underhand tricks of a teenage romance. Life reunited with her father is a huge disappointment for Zara.

videos.title: Careless Whisper
videos.overview: The elderly mother of a Downs Syndrome girl is about to go on a trip to America, only she's a bit poorly and has to get the doctor out. She's been not-so-secretly earning extra money as a phone sex worker, so her daughter takes up the mantle. Julia is a bit shocked. Zara takes her dad to a local Over 50's Community Coffee Morning, though she can't wait to get out, it reminds her of 'Cocoon'. Her dad wants to play table tennis though. Poor Zara. Simon turns to Ruth to talk about his break-up.

videos.title: Monday, Monday
videos.overview: Will has to play judge, jury and executioner to a liar. And Simon struggles to cope with Will's absence in his life.

videos.title: All The Right Moves
