videos.overview: A romantic tryst and a massive hairy metalhead ensure that Jack's first day in halls does not go quite to plan. And has romance really left Simon's life?

videos.title: The False Heart
videos.overview: A troublesome young actor is having terrible nightmares and heart trouble. Heston helps him out. Karen is on industrial work-to-rule, which causes lots of bother. It's all back on with Simon and Will, but Simon doesn't want Cherry to know. Ruth becomes his partner-in-crime to stop her from knowing.

videos.title: Idle Hands
videos.overview: A vagrant is caught by Rob, just after he claims that he killed a girl by touching her with his bare hand. She was just involved in a car accident though. Jimmi gets involved. Will he be his next 'victim'. Zara's father continues to be a bit down-in-the-dumps. He burns his hand, so Cherry goes around to look at it. They have some ironing fun and she stops for dinner, much to Zara's annoyance. Heston gives Karen an envelope with some money in it, to hopefully stop her work-to-rule. Unfortunately he's taken it from the biscuit fund.

videos.title: Baby Love
videos.overview: It's snowing again in Letherbridge, and Michelle has had her tyre slashed. Luckily a neighbor is there to help. He is a big Mowtown fan and has a bow tie given to him by Smokey Robinson in 1965. He's living in the past, and secretly fancies her. Imagine her surprise when he tries to kiss her at the local tea dance. Zara drags her dad to a posh restaurant, but it all ends in tears. He wants to move into a place of his own. Ruth has to find someone else to lead the tap dance troupe, as Charlie has gout again. She targets Jimmi.

videos.title: Like Mother Like Daughter
videos.overview: Charlie helps a mother and daughter after they discover they are both dating the same man. Zara has an emotional turn when helping her dad move into his new sheltered accommodation. She thinks it's poky and "you can't even open the windows". Jack tries to cheer her up. Julia starts hunting down the missing petty cash, so many biscuits just seems wrong.

videos.title: An Officer and a Gentleman
videos.overview: Rob catches an incompetent colleague in an amorous embrace with Susie, whilst both at work. What will he do? Immie helps a male friend when he sees the girl he's supposed to marry out with another man.

videos.title: All Our Yesterdays
videos.overview: Cherry goes and sees a couple, the wife is struggling with memory loss. She doesn't remember the big crash. Simon has it out again with Will. He wants him to leave his wife. Charlie sees them hug, and has a go at them for being 'abnormal'. Jimmi tries to sort out the Karen problem.

videos.title: The Power Of Speech
videos.overview: Heston's rhetoric proves invaluable in a matter of life and death for an eccentric family. A surprise visitor at the Mill makes Simon question his future with Will. Will Zara and Daniel be able to secure the money he needs for the partnership?

videos.title: Lady Luck
videos.overview: Heston clashes with a charismatic traveller who claims to possess 'second sight' - when she sets up camp in the car park, Heston makes it his business to remove her.

videos.title: Street Life
videos.overview: Love is in the air for Jimmi at the police station when his methadone addict patient tries to play matchmaker, while Zara has a big shock for a despondent Daniel. Simon goes to see Will, determined to end things once and for all, but can he go through with it?

videos.title: Consequences
videos.overview: Simon is shocked when Sophie corners him at the Mill. Heston is furious when he discovers that Julia has lied to Daniel about the partnership money, but they have to formulate a plan quickly when Daniel confronts them.

videos.title: Sins Of A Father
videos.overview: Michelle helps her friend Josh confront his mother's past when his girlfriend unearths a dark family secret; will Josh be able to forgive his mother for lying to him? Will and Sophie reach a compromise about their marriage, while Heston has an idea to breathe new life into the tap dance routine.

videos.title: The Loneliness of the Long Distance Unicyclist
videos.overview: Karen discovers that she has become the unwitting star of a unicycling comedian's interactive comedy act - will she see the funny side? Simon desperately tries to ignore Will's pleas to see him - will he break? And Zara gives Daniel an idea about his future career.

videos.title: Pound of Flesh
videos.overview: When Julia discovers that a young, head-strong patient at The Mill has sold her virginity to an older man, she tries to convince her that it might not be a good idea.

videos.title: Burning the Candle
videos.overview: An offensively ageist patient causes Charlie to miss a potentially lethal condition. Can he track down the patient before it is too late? Daniel discovers pride comes before a fall, and Ruth frantically attempts to fix the costumes for the gala.

videos.title: The White Room
videos.overview: Simon attempts to save a man who takes drastic steps after his wife falls into a coma. Unbeknown to him, his wife is suffering a similar internal struggle to live. Cherry moves back in with Simon and decides to cheer him up with home cooking.

videos.title: The Tiptoe of Expectation
videos.overview: A young girl goes to Zara for help, convinced her elderly aunt is going mad. Meanwhile, a young intruder gets more than he bargained for when he breaks into the aunt's house. Daniel plucks up the courage to say sorry to Julia, and Cherry throws herself at a bemused Heston!

videos.title: The Last Hurrah
videos.overview: Rob is assaulted by a drunken 15-year-old girl and takes her into custody. The girl refuses to reveal her name, and so Rob does some investigating of his own.

videos.title: Heaven, I'm in Heaven
videos.overview: Heston suffers from foot-in-mouth disease when reviewing Cherry's style in clothing. As stage fright starts to take a hold of Ruth just one day before the gala, she desperately searches for a way out. Jack and Immie clash as they both struggle to get their work done under one roof.

videos.title: Shuffle, Ball, Change
videos.overview: It is the day of the gala, but will Ruth be able to overcome her stage fright and pull off her elaborate solo? Imogen endeavours to boost Ruth's confidence.

videos.title: Pass the Parcel
videos.overview: Michelle takes matters into her own hands when she fears that an elderly patient is being mistreated by his two sons. Charlie gets some good news, while Simon's day goes from bad to worse.

videos.title: Me Not I
videos.overview: A patient of Heston's starts to believe that he is becoming someone else. Imogen is stressed out about her art exam, while Ruth feels deflated after the gala.

videos.title: Domo Arigato, Super San
videos.overview: Cherry plays detective by uncovering a rather 'super' villain. Julia's old friend Rowly makes a splash at the Mill, and Karen comes to a big decision.

videos.title: Past Tense
videos.overview: Rob discovers a killer in Letherbridge who has a target alarmingly close to home. Julia's friendship with Rowly takes an unexpected turn, while the tension between Zara and Daniel reaches boiling point.

videos.title: You Will Survive
videos.overview: Simon finds himself tangled up with a morally ambiguous student. Daniel wants to know what's going on with Zara, while Julia gets some relationship advice.

videos.title: The Light Fantastic
videos.overview: Ruth finds herself with a sweet stalker who she discovers actually needs someone to care for him. Jimmi tries to give nervous young patient Colin the benefit of his dating experience, but is alarmed to discover that his protege could actually be stalking the object of his affections.

videos.title: Class Act
videos.overview: It's the day of Heston's soiree, but will Cherry be able to keep up the pretence? And it is crunch time for Julia and Rowly as they go on a date.

videos.title: A Nod and a Wink
videos.overview: Cherry helps a professional winker to pursue his goal to become world champion. Heston steps in to show Rowly that being flamboyant doesn't mean being alone.

videos.title: Ghosts
videos.overview: Rob has a run-in with a not-so-private eye, while Linda is shocked to see Charlie out and about, and practising medicine.

videos.title: Legacy
videos.overview: Daniel helps a dying friend realise there are things you cannot run away from. And Linda goes to the Mill to confront Charlie - but what dark secret is lurking in his past?

videos.title: The Trouble with Charlie
videos.overview: Charlie's dark past, and the reason he left his old practice, are revealed - what does Linda have over him?

videos.title: Daddy Un-Cool
videos.overview: Jack's party lifestyle has seemingly put him in seriously hot water. The ghosts of Christmas past come back to haunt Charlie - but can he keep that past under wraps?

videos.title: Love Thy Neighbour
videos.overview: When a female vicar finds herself on the receiving end of a hate campaign, Daniel steps up to unearth the culprit. Julia's catch-up chats with the gang don't go to plan, while Karen returns from her HCA course with an unusual strategy for deciding the colour of her uniform.

videos.title: Through a Glass Darkly
videos.overview: An acquaintance of Ruth's is convinced his wife's personality has been mysteriously altered, but only Ruth believes him. Can Ruth convince Simon to help?

videos.title: Ties That Bind
videos.overview: When a disgruntled patient bemoans her neglectful husband, Cherry tries to show her that the grass isn't always greener. Zara intervenes when a friend has second thoughts on his wedding day, but has she taken it too far?

videos.title: Who's Coming to Dinner?
videos.overview: Heston helps a father who takes extreme action rather than meet his in-laws for the first time. After the disaster with Jimmi, Karen doubts she will find anyone else to practise on, but is surprised by her first volunteer.

videos.title: Tuning In The Shine
videos.overview: Imogen uses an unusual method to set a stressed young couple's rocky relationship back on a smoother path. Will Julia's meddling ruin her dinner with Simon? Will Karen succeed in finding volunteers to help her practise? And Daniel's lonely night ends well when he overhears a surprising conversation.

videos.title: Gibberish
videos.overview: Julia helps a neighbour with dementia, and discovers the horrific truth about her new boyfriend. Karen shocks Rob with how far she will go to practise taking blood, while Heston makes an appointment with Michelle which could change her life, and Julia tries to make amends for her disastrous dinner with Simon.

videos.title: Miss Pringle Investigates
videos.overview: When septuagenarian Elsie believes that her neighbour in her sheltered accommodation has gone missing, she ropes in Charlie to help her investigate.

videos.title: Some Like it Hot
videos.overview: Jack's birthday barbecue arrives, and the punch is flowing. Cherry is upset when Jimmi cannot get away from the police station, but manages to drown her sorrows.

videos.title: Nappy Rash
videos.overview: When a nosey housewife accuses her neighbour of running an unlicensed nursery for children of illegal immigrants, Zara discovers that the truth is far more bizarre. An embarrassed and devastated Cherry can barely show her face at work, while Michelle is nervous on her first day at Housman.

videos.title: How Green is Your Home?
videos.overview: Ruth goes on a date with a man more concerned with world conservation than self-preservation, while Michelle relishes the challenge of working with soldiers.

videos.title: Visible Wounds
videos.overview: Medical drama series. A medal-winning hero battles with a severe head injury, while Cherry tells Simon she has blown her chances with Jimmi.

videos.title: Back to School
videos.overview: Medical drama series. Simon finds an old friend caught in the middle of an awkward power struggle between a school's deputy headmistress and a headstrong pupil.

videos.title: Day Zero
videos.overview: Karen is determined to impress on her first day as a HCA. However, undermining Cherry and accusing a patient of lying is not a great start. Michelle struggles to get Chris to admit his body is healing itself, and a phone call with his sergeant back in Afghanistan does not help matters.

videos.title: Not Otherwise
videos.overview: Medical drama series. Charlie gives a domineering war photographer a medical check-up and manages to refrain from offending her, but has he missed something vital?

videos.title: Army Dreamers
videos.overview: Chris faces his final assessments, but the stress gets too much for him. He is prescribed a trip to the pub with Michelle, who finally gets to the bottom of his strange behaviour. Meanwhile, Heston offers Immie the chance of a lifetime - but what will Rob say?

videos.title: Peace Love and Understanding
videos.overview: Julia gets caught in the middle of two warring divorce lawyers, who decide to up their game when they discover they have a husband and wife as their clients. Meanwhile, Michelle takes a stand for consumer rights and ends up at the police station.

videos.title: Happy Place
videos.overview: Simon is faced with an undertaker who keeps collapsing, and comes up with the perfect remedy after an encounter with a pug dog called Eric. Daniel wants a relationship with Zara, and forces her to go on a date with him to a bowling alley. Meanwhile Rob gets wind of Immie and Karen's plot.

videos.title: Small Town Hero
videos.overview: Ruth encounters a reluctant young hero who saved his mother from a blazing fire. However, Jimmi suspects all is not well in the family home. Daniel has a business meeting on the golf course, and is made an offer he cannot refuse.

videos.title: Gentle Giant
videos.overview: Zara becomes protective when an acquitted man is persecuted by the father of one of his supposed victims. Karen tries to mend things between Immie and Rob while Michelle has a lunch date to remember.

videos.title: The View From Here
videos.overview: Anna tries to play peacemaker when a bitter old soldier decides to make life difficult for his frightened new roommate. Simon's day goes from bad to worse when he's assaulted at the campus, while Rob tries to connect with his daughter.

videos.title: Finding the Words
videos.overview: Medical drama. Jimmi is asked for help by a monk who is tortured by events from his past. Zara decides to cheer Simon up, while Michelle treats a familiar face.

videos.title: Healer
videos.overview: When Rob catches Karen up to no good, their resultant argument pushes him towards some very "alternative" help. Meanwhile, Jack and Imogen struggle to come to terms with Gaz's injuries.

videos.title: The Big Picture
videos.overview: Michelle finds herself entangled with a dotty octogenarian who is on a mission to find her lost cat. Immie goes to see Gaz on her own, while Jack takes out his anger on Anna in an interview for the student magazine.

videos.title: Five Seconds
videos.overview: Medical drama series. A day in the life of new dad Johnny is played out in new ways as he follows relationship advice from both Heston and Charlie. But whose advice will save his rocky marriage?

videos.title: Daddy's Home
videos.overview: When her father comes home after ten years, a young Cliff Richard fan has to face up to the fantasy world she has created. Julia gets an exciting lead, while Michelle is full of admiration when her first military patient from the Housman Ward returns fully recovered and raring to get back to work.

videos.title: Wedded Miss
videos.overview: An old friend of Cherry's is getting married, but why is the best man so unhappy? Heston finds himself surrounded by buffoons, while Michelle takes stock of her life as she approaches her thirtieth birthday.

videos.title: Time to Go
videos.overview: Ruth's afternoon off takes an unusual turn when she meets an old acquaintance who refuses to leave her alone. Julia is furious with Heston, while Michelle makes a life-changing decision and drops a bombshell on her mother.

videos.title: The Long Way Round - Part One
videos.overview: When a woman finds a young asylum seeker hiding in her garden, Simon is called out to help. But they are all unaware of the danger lurking nearby. The Mill team find themselves under siege by reporters, while Cherry does some detective work.

videos.title: The Long Way Round - Part Two
videos.overview: As Kim and Monica grow suspicious of their neighbour, Simon again tries to help as things go from bad to worse for Saleem. Unaware of her plans, Louis declares his feelings for Michelle, while Heston comes face-to-face with Dr Diana - but with disastrous consequences.

videos.title: Canute
videos.overview: Medical drama series. Rob and Jimmi risk their safety to try and help a man whose house is falling down around him, while Michelle says a final farewell to Letherbridge.

videos.title: Marry in Haste
videos.overview: Ruth's plans for her day off go awry when she gets involved in her neighbour's marital strife. Heston continues to prove that doctors make the worst patients, until a new nurse brightens his day. Cherry and Jimmi bond over an unusual case.

videos.title: Naked Ambition
videos.overview: Medical drama series. Charlie's sister visits the Mill and enlists his help in some marital espionage, while Cassandra proves to be a real tonic for Heston.

videos.title: Kiss and Make Up
videos.overview: Derek and his wife Mitsy are on the local radio to help promote their new self-help relationship book. They also have a drop-in day at their clinic. Unfortunately a tale about a past girlfriend 'Mara' hits a chord with Zara - for it is she, and he was already married. Very annoyed, she drags Simon in to expose and ruin him. Unfortunately Mitsy gets caught in the crossfire. Julia calls in a woman to help with the Mill's efficiency, which results in war between her, Julia and Karen.

videos.title: Poetic Justice
videos.overview: A man, just out of prison, is constantly getting harassed, vandalized and is the victim of anti-social behavior. A young thug believes he killed his dad. Rob gets involved to try and sort it all out. Cassandra and Heston keep getting closer, but does she go too far? Jack talks to his dad about his next big story for the student rag. An itchy spot has appeared on Julia's back, so she gets Karen to have a look at it.

videos.title: Scoop
videos.overview: Jack is writing a new article for the student paper. He's investigating Mr Quinn, the Head of Admissions, who he thinks is admitting undeserving students. He has help from miss Laker, who says is being bullied by Mr Quinn. Jack discovers that journalism isn't quite as straight forward as he thinks though. Cassandra tells Heston that she thinks they are soul mates, but how will he react?

videos.title: A Call of Nature
videos.overview: Julia is at home ill. Her pipes are also faulty. Unfortunately the new Chief Executive of the PCT is visiting the Mill. It falls to a put-upon Ruth to deal with him. Heston is only just out of hospital, but still pops into work. An old eccentric, poorly recluse has trouble from a badger-baiting youth. Daniel gets involved, then it all gets out of hand.

videos.title: Standing Up
videos.overview: Immie takes Gaz to an Open Mic comedy gig at 'The Laughter Shack', but she is disgusted by the terrible treatment they get from the compère. She decides to try and get back at him. Daniel invites Zara to a new posh restaurant, only she gets a call from her cousin so can't go. He decides to take Jimmi instead, but it ends up with the four of them going, much to Cherry's dismay. Julia gets to the truth about Ruth and Mr Galliflakis.

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye Baby
videos.overview: Simon bumps into a teenage girl with a baby who is obviously upset. He tries to help but gets the brush off. That's not the end of the matter though. An ex boyfriend's mother tries to see Cherry. She wants to have lunch, but why?

videos.title: A serious Woman
videos.overview: After her lack of success with Jimmi, and having dreams of herself floating in water, Cherry decides to get rid of everything pink and take herself more seriously. Her day would soon end up in real waters though, helping a drowning man, with Jimmi to the rescue. Julia is ill at work, so Zara takes her home and decides to play nursemaid.

videos.title: Double Bogey
videos.overview: Cherry is in hospital following her brush with death, and all she can think about is her savior - Jimmi. Charlie thinks he's got a way into a prestigious golf club in Letherbridge, having saved the Chairman's wife from choking at a party. Only it won't be prestigious for long if he joins! Julia is back at work. She's very stressed and having a go at Karen.

videos.title: Frozen
videos.overview: A woman goes to see Daniel for Botox. She wants to look like she did in an old photo she's brought with her. Daniel has his doubts though - she talks to people who aren't there, and her doctor and husband say she's dead. Elaine is relaxing at home, in the middle of a long term relationship that's going no-where. She wants to get back to work, and the Mill is her target. Julia is still feeling ill - she's got the shakes and falls asleep in the strangest of places.

videos.title: Double Top
videos.overview: A local darts legend comes to the Mill. He has 'dartitis', so Karen tries to sort him out, with fan Rob's help. Julia, Heston and Daniel interview for the new doctor, with Elaine as the least favorite. Is that about to change though? Jimmi and Cherry go on a not entirely successful first date.

videos.title: A Boy Called Granddad
videos.overview: Spanner is working with the police to trap granddad in a drunks ring. Granddad is such named because he walks like one. He accuses Jimmi of police brutality, but it seems he has a brittle bone disease. Julia is tricked by Heston into asking Ruth for help in her PCT presentation. Elaine is having a lazy day shaving her legs, and asks Paul to go with her to Letherbride. He doesn't want to but presents her with a new house opportunity. Then she gets the job offer from Heston. What is she to do?

videos.title: Hanging On
videos.overview: Even though her memory loss is worsening, Julia tries to help a woman whose husband died recently. She still talks to him though, and he follows her around. Her daughter is dealing with the loss in a very different way. Elaine discovers that Paul lied to her about the house, just to stop her from moving to Letherbridge. She's very annoyed, so makes a momentous decision. Cherry talks to Simon about her Jimmi concerns.

videos.title: And Shame the Devil
videos.overview: Rob gets pulled from pillar to post, as everyone wants a piece of him. He also gets called into work, is his old nemesis 'Verity the Viper' back in action? All he wants to do though, is go fishing. It's Elaine's first day at the Mill, and she gets the full 'pervy' treatment from Charlie. Cherry tries her 'Demon Spawn Doctor Test' on Jimmi, to discover how far his foibles go.

videos.title: The Trainee - Part One
videos.overview: After a posh party and against Julia's better wishes, one of the chief consultants of the PCT asks Daniel to mentor one of his students for a couple of days. Only he acts a bit weird and keeps disappearing. Elaine starts fighting back against Charlie's charm offensive, and Julia's mood goes from bad to worse.

videos.title: The Trainee - Part Two
videos.overview: Michael's behavior gets stranger by the minute, and after an outburst at the surgery, Daniel tells him to get out. Heston gives Crossland some advice over breakfast - it seems Michael has some hold over him which could wreck his marriage. Julia gets ever more stressed and bad tempered over the upcoming presentation, with Ruth getting the brunt of it.

videos.title: La La La (Not Listening)
videos.overview: Simon finds his final assessment in tatters after Heston points out an article in the latest medical rag. Elaine has a home visit, only the patient, who's a musician and has a performance coming up, is coughing up blood. He refuses to listen to her advice. Julia thinks she may have Parkinsons.

videos.title: Something Evil
videos.overview: Kye is scared of the woods outside the back of her house. She keeps getting flashes of red fire, and senses something evil. Her dad thinks she's psychically blessed. Heston discovers it all leads to something very close to home. Zara returns and is furious when she finds her room has been turned into a 'Hippy Squat'. It's the day of the presentation at the PCT, only Ruth has to step up when Julia falls apart.

videos.title: The Price
videos.overview: A friend of Simon's takes him along to see an astrophysicist, who even though discredited, has started a 'cult' organization. His name is Blake, and they all dress like Star Trek characters. Or is there something more sinister lurking? It's Ruth's first day in charge, as Julia is off sick. Only she's trying a bit too hard. Julia gets a surprise visit at home, Zara is out to get Elaine, but is totally disarmed.

videos.title: A Spoonful
videos.overview: Zara has an exquisite gateau delivered especially from France, and plans to eat one piece a day over four days. It's not that easy though. She bets a slice that Cherry can't make Ruth laugh out loud, and, called to attend a local boxing match, she makes a big mistake in taking the cake with her. She also discovers that all is not as it seems when the young boxer has a nasty fall.

videos.title: Man in the Mirror
videos.overview: An old friend of Charlie's is recently bereaved. She keeps seeing her dead husband in the mirror, so goes to Charlie for help. She tells him that it says in the will that there is a secret box kept in an upstairs safe, which must be delivered to the solicitor unopened. This scares Charlie, and he's determined to see inside her box. Julia falls asleep while looking after Chloe, who ends up scalded. Julia calls everyone by the wrong name.

videos.title: Paradise Lost
videos.overview: Jimmi and Cherry wake up in bed, only Jimmi calls her Eva. She's naturally perturbed. Two yobs pinch some flowers from a florist, which end up on Jimmi's car. Jimmi finds them, together with a previously left 'sorry' note from Cherry! Confusion reigns, especially when the police turn up. Julia takes Chloe to the zoo, only loses her. Simon thinks there may be something wrong with Julia.

videos.title: Echoes
videos.overview: A man wakes up in hospital with eye patches on. He's been in a crash, but doesn't remember it and doesn't recognize his brother's voice. Jack is shadowing the sexy, yet cynical solicitor on the case. He spots that something's afoot and wants to delve deeper. She doesn't. Will he get into serious trouble or save the day? Simon, Cherry and Ruth all voice their concern over Julia to Heston. He's a tough nut though, and doesn't believe anything's wrong.

videos.title: Voice Activated
videos.overview: Jimmi goes around to visit Julia to try and find out what's wrong with her. It's the day of the Freshers Ball, and the band are struggling with their rehearsals. The lead singer then gets a phone call which threatens to mess everything up. It's up to Elaine to help sort it all out.

videos.title: Off the Wagon
videos.overview: Simon loses it when Charlie says one homophobic remark too many. Unfortunately Daniel is in charge and thinks he's making a mountain out of a molehill. Cherry sees a woman who has Motor Neurone Disease. She badly cuts herself when she drops a mug. Her husband is struggling to cope with her and their wayward teenage daughter.

videos.title: Bonkers
videos.overview: Julia is having one heck of a day. All her work colleagues keep popping up in her house, though some of them she thinks are her family. Everything's all messed up, and to top it all, two annoying people keep knocking on her door. Are they real, or are we in Julia's fevered subconscious? Or is it a mixture of both?

videos.title: Carnage
videos.overview: Charlie visits Julia, only she believes that he's Mac, her husband. He spends the night with her. Ruth is shocked to find him there the next morning, wearing Mac's old dressing gown and even more perturbed when Julia tells her that he was 'forceful' with her. What are Ruth and Heston to do, and has Charlie finally gone too far?

videos.title: Two Marriages
videos.overview: Patrick continues to look after Julia while she continues to have tests in hospital, while the staff of the Mill continue to come to terms with it all. Heston empties out Charlie's things from his room. Rob has to attend a dull 'Managing Suspicion' police course, but soon gets a call from a desperate colleague. Immie meets Gio, and she's head over heels!

videos.title: Good Clean Fun
videos.overview: Two stupid students' jolly japing goes too far when one of them glues the others fingers to his penis. With really strong glue. Immie dolls herself up for a hopefully second meeting with Gio. Elaine convinces Patrick to allow Julia to have some visitors. Now that she's being treated for Limes Disease, just how much will she remember?

videos.title: The Go-Between
videos.overview: Cherry tries to match-make two friends at her morning yoga sessions, but it doesn't quite work out as she would have hoped. Elaine moves into Charlie's old room, but while she's making it all nice, she seems to become the one person that everyone else wants to talk to about Julia and Charlie. Immie goes for coffee with her dreamy poetry spouting Italian hunk.

videos.title: Under The Gooseberry Bush
videos.overview: First into work in the morning, Zara finds a new born baby on the Mill doorstep. Despite her initial detachment, the baby girl soon brings out the emotional and human side of her. Gio turns up at Immie's art class playing romantic music and carrying flowers. So smitten is she that they try and have sex, only to be interrupted by Jack. He gets mad, but will she be able to stop him telling their mum.

videos.title: Von Man Trap
videos.overview: Meredith Von Trapp sees Daniel about the pill. She's a virgin and has a phobia of all things sexual, and keeps putting her boyfriend off from having sex. She also happens to be a stripper. Daniel and Jimmi go to a stag do, where the stripper is...! Heston goes to see an old friend, who is a 'serial canceler', but ends up on his new Segway.

videos.title: Independence Day
videos.overview: Jack wakes up after a wild party, only to have to help a girl to hospital. She's vomiting, after taking something she shouldn't have. He also has to deal with a mad and violent relation of hers, who just won't go away. Charlie gets sex education tips from Cherry and Zara - mainly Zara. Ruth visits Henry, only to receive some shocking news.

videos.title: Honey Monster
videos.overview: Ruth goes to apologize to Henry for her outburst, and they have tea and muffins. He is still determined to end their sessions, so she loses it again. He then tells her the real reason for wanting to move away. A young girl is killed, and Jimmi treats a woman who has seen the killer. Immie invites Gio around for lunch, much to Karen's surprise. So much for having sex on the sofa!

videos.title: The No Man
videos.overview: Ruth asks Simon if he can find out what he can about MS, as Henry is moving away to look after his ex wife who has it. She has a last meeting with him, tap dances for him, and puts on a brave face. Two men have trouble coping with their Telly Sales boss, who's a bit of a ball-breaker. Simon helps the one guy, Jamie, who has missed an appointment and is now ill.

videos.title: Love You To Death
videos.overview: Elaine bumps into a patient, who is having lots of sex, all the wrong food, and is piling on the pounds. Is it all innocent, or is there something more sinister underneath? Rob finds out about Immie and Gio, and jumps in with both feet first. So they invite Gio around for dinner, much to Immie's embarrassment.

videos.title: Whatever Happened to Auntie Jane?
videos.overview: A wheelchair-bound woman is convinced that her boyfriend killed her sister Jane. But where's the body, and what will Cherry think of it all. Still recovering from the night before, Immie is starting to get a bit fed up of Gio's constant pestering of her.

videos.title: No Love Lost
videos.overview: Jo's mother thinks that she is harming her daughter again. She noticed some bruises, so went to the cops. Rob and Jimmi get involved. Gio stopped over with Jack, he's heartbroken and is drinking. Jack thinks Zara is just the person to give him advice about his broken heart. Zara has a great Friday night with Daniel, only wakes up later with the hot sweats.

videos.title: Close to Home
videos.overview: An old friend of Hestons wants to go to Hong Kong, only her father is dying. Heston gets involved in a complicated family situation. It's Julia's first day back at work, and she is bowled over by the enthusiasm of everyones welcome. Is she coping with it okay though, as she's having flashbacks to her imagined time when she was ill? Zara snaps at Daniel when he constantly voices concern over her hot flushes.

videos.title: Keep It In the Trade
videos.overview: The Mill boiler isn't working, so Karen calls the plummer. He may be fit (according to Zara and Cherry), but he's got a phobia of mice, which is a problem when he discovers loads of mice droppings everywhere. Karen decides to help him by introducing Rodney into the proceedings. It's the day of Elaine's first morning meeting, but it's more difficult to arrange than one would think.

videos.title: Mad Hatters
videos.overview: An old friend of Julia's is having a relapse of an old condition, which has the effect of her seeing strange hallucinations. Her son-in-law goes to Julia, thinking she's faking it, and asks Julia to help. Elaine has another go at having her first staff meeting, she's even baked proper gluten-full muffins. Zara continues to hide from having an emotional conversation with Daniel.

videos.title: The Flood
videos.overview: Zara wakes up with the hot sweats again, and Daniel is fed up with her lying to him all the time. He gets Cherry to ask her over to Jimmi's for a four-way dinner party - she's cooking. Jimmi finds out that Cherry has made a mess in the toilet, and used all his towels to clean it up. He shows her how to clean properly. Daniel finally corners Zara, and she tells him everything.

videos.title: Ed
videos.overview: Rob has been drafted in to help CID on an observation, but he gets distracted when a rambling homeless man starts going on about a dead body. He used to be a soldier, so Rob thinks he's hallucinating, as there's now no body. Will Rob be able to keep his mind on the job in hand, or will the watch be ruined? Daniel has a lot to think about after Zara's revelation, and is worrying too much. Zara is at the Campus, and is also fretting. She confides in Ruth, so Ruth gives her some beetroot salad.

videos.title: Boyo
videos.overview: A handsome school friend of Jimmi's creates a stir with the women at the Mill. Rhys reminisces with Jimmi, but their conversation takes a more sinister turn when he reveals he is being followed.

videos.title: Perfect
videos.overview: Ruth runs into an old friend of an old boyfriend while looking for her Manual Handling course. They seem to be getting on very well so he joins Ruth an Cherry for lunch. Unfortunately he seems to have a heavily pregnant wife. Fed up with his slovenly lifestyle, Jack decides to start jogging, but gets the mickey taken out of him by some other much fitter joggers. Elaine meets a handsome stranger when she gets lost a St Phil's on her way to a meeting.

videos.title: Breathing Lessons
videos.overview: Concerned that Heston gives prescription drugs to patients far too easily, Elaine, Zara and Ruth bet him that he can't go just one day without giving any. Unfortunately the scrub nurse that used to terrify him when he was young arrives, demanding her beta blockers. He ends up going to a wedding with her. Dr. Richard Cane calls Elaine trying to apologize to her for yesterday, and wants to have lunch. Jack wants to write a story about Tony, as he's so fit.

Sasha is taking 'calorie-busters' and not sleeping, and Jack is not eating. Sasha tells Immie, who is far from impressed, especially when Sasha disappears from a test. Jack is trying to keep up with the other bigger, fitter boys in the gym. Elaine accuses Richard of stalking her, when he turns up at the Mill, in an interview with Julia. Cherry dumps Jimmi for Angelina, then gets paranoid that she's upset him.

videos.title: Fire and Water
videos.overview: Can Rob beat the experts when a famous painting goes missing in Letherbridge? Relations are strained between Simon and Cherry while events take a dark turn for Jack.

videos.title: Carousel Part 1
videos.overview: Daniel and Zara enjoy a last-minute shopping trip with Izzie before their holiday, but their day turns into a nightmare when Izzie disappears from a carousel. Distraught, Daniel searches for her on the busy streets of Letherbridge.

videos.title: Carousel Part 2
videos.overview: Daniel and Lisa make a desperate plea for Izzie's safe return, while local news reporter Adam digs deep into Daniel's past. Meanwhile, the police follow a promising lead.

videos.title: Carousel Part 3
videos.overview: As the search for Izzie continues, a fraught Daniel decides to do some of his own investigating. Meanwhile Lisa reveals some new information, which makes Daniel a prime suspect. Christopher is reeling after the discovery that his new sister was abducted by his parents; what should he do?

videos.title: Carousel Part 4
videos.overview: Zara risks her career by giving Kev what he wants in return for information about Izzie's disappearance. Adam turns on Lisa on live television, and Christopher remains locked in his room as the Oakleys consider their options.

videos.title: Carousel Part 5
videos.overview: New evidence comes to light following Christopher's accident, resulting in Daniel and Zara finding the home of Izzie's abductors - but is it too late? The discovery of a grave sends Adam down a gruesome journalistic path.

videos.title: The Memory of Water
videos.overview: Heston once again prepares to do battle with his nemesis Dr Diana. While Zara and the Mill team deal with the fallout from Izzie's kidnap, and Elaine makes a decision.

videos.title: The Comeback Kid
videos.overview: Ruth is taken back to her school days when her old music teacher prepares to audition for a new TV talent show. Karen worries about Jack while he is faced with a new challenge.

videos.title: The Puppet Master
videos.overview: Elaine provides medical advice to an actor but is concerned that his intense commitment to the role is affecting his health.

videos.title: Arrivals
videos.overview: There are surprising results when Karen finds herself in the middle of a bizarre office competition. A drunken Zara confesses all to Ruth, while Rob ends a boring day with an exciting opportunity - but will he go for it?

videos.title: Tiny Whispers
videos.overview: Cherry struggles with a moral dilemma when she deals with a teenager displaying worrying symptoms. Daniel is reaching the end of his tether with Lisa's paranoia, but a surprise visitor brings him the support he needs.

videos.title: Sonata
videos.overview: Julia and Joe come together to reunite a beautiful pianist with her overbearing mother. Jack's obsession with exercise puts his health at risk, and Joe worries about Daniel and Lisa's relationship.

videos.title: Encounters
videos.overview: A blast from the past forces Simon to explain his actions, while unwanted house-guests are the order of the day as Daniel struggles to placate Lisa. Elsewhere, an unexpected visitor sends the Hollinses into red alert.

videos.title: If Tomorrow Never Comes
videos.overview: An anniversary, a surprise party and a second chance put Jimmi's medical impartiality to the test.

videos.title: The Me Who Came To Dinner
videos.overview: A soiree with the Elite Dining Club helps Heston come to a realisation about his life. Julia and Joe have a soiree of their own, but Julia falls foul of one too many glasses of wine and takes Joe by surprise.

videos.title: A Rocky Road
videos.overview: The arrival of a handsome stranger halts Elaine's plans for a peaceful weekend retreat. Julia apologises to Joe and is taken aback by his news.

videos.title: Martha Loves George
videos.overview: When Julia's old Brown Owl arrives at the campus with her nervous fiance in tow, she soon discovers why he is getting cold feet. Heston insists he is fine when he hurts his back and hobbles into work - he finds that his colleagues have varying degrees of sympathy and suggestions of help.

videos.title: The Stripper and the Librarian
videos.overview: Cherry becomes an impromptu fairy godmother to an apparently mismatched young couple. Heston relents to some hands-on treatment from Elaine for his back. Tony and Jack clash when they meet a gorgeous girl at the gym.

videos.title: Tough Enough
videos.overview: Still contemplating Joe's job offer, Ruth has to deal with a challenging patient. The atmosphere between Zara and Daniel is beginning to be felt by everyone but will they be helped?

videos.title: Wasted Trip
videos.overview: Heston faces an ethical dilemma when an arthritis-ridden patient challenges his attitude to her pain relief. Jack and Immie's sibling argument spirals out of control with shocking consequences.

videos.title: Everybody Hurts
videos.overview: While Karen tries to track down Jack, he runs into Zara at The Campus, where his behaviour spirals even further out of control. Ruth has a surprise visitor.

videos.title: Hex
videos.overview: Medical drama series. Jimmi encounters a teenage girl who believes she has killed her stepmother - but why can't they find a body? Ruth and Connie spend the day together.

videos.title: An Unexpected Arrival
videos.overview: Medical drama. Zara finds herself caught in the middle as a teacher tries to juggle the two women in his life. Meanwhile, Jack has to face his father.

videos.title: Bon Vomage
videos.overview: Medical drama. Heston and Jimmi have to deal with two students who like to party hard, while Simon meets an old flame in the most awkward of places.

videos.title: Dirty Little Pig
videos.overview: A social worker tries to help a sexually-aggressive boy and his mother, with shocking consequences. Jack organises a treat for Imogen.

videos.title: I Know What You Did Last Night
videos.overview: Cherry rescues a hapless groom-to-be on the morning of his wedding. Julia is shocked to discover who Ruth is meeting for lunch, while Simon finds himself defending a patient and his integrity.

videos.title: My Girl Lollipop
videos.overview: Lollipop lady Christine is hiding two life-changing secrets which threaten to tear her happy marriage apart. Heston helps her to see that honesty is the best policy. Simon confronts Lesley about her lie to Najmah. Cherry worries that she and Jimmi are getting boring.

videos.title: Father To The Man
videos.overview: Jimmi is stuck between a father and son facing their last chance to save their relationship - can he help them find peace with one another? Ruth considers with her counsellor if she is ready to trust her mother again.

videos.title: The Bitterest Pill
videos.overview: Rob has a moral and ethical dilemma whilst embroiled in a case about missing pharmaceuticals. Simon does some investigating while Lesley has to answer more of Najmah's questions. Meanwhile Jimmi surprises Cherry!

videos.title: There Must Be an Angel
videos.overview: Simon takes matters into his own hands when he learns that one of his patients is being harassed by social services. Daniel is furious to learn that Zara has been offered a partnership behind his back, while Cherry and Jimmi get competitive on the tennis court.

videos.title: Fault Lines
videos.overview: Lesley's panicked call to the police is responded to by Rob, who finds her estranged husband Sam trying to escape through the back door. A tragic discovery is made, but is everything as it seems?

videos.title: The Caring Business
videos.overview: Julia's day takes a festive turn when her former car mechanic finds himself in financial trouble. Simon takes the news about Scarlett alarmingly well, while Ruth struggles to stand up to Connie.

videos.title: If You Want Something Done...
videos.overview: Karen's attempts to unblock her kitchen sink start a chain reaction of events that quickly spiral out of control. Ruth finally tells Connie about her new job in America, while Simon is horrified to discover the true extent of Scarlett's injuries.

videos.title: The Living Gaylights
videos.overview: Struggling with the fallout from the Hammond case, Simon slips into his own fantasy world. He takes on the role of Bond - Doctor Bond. His mission: to save the Mr Gay Letherbridge pageant and avert World War 3, whilst encountering some familiar faces along the way.

videos.title: Inside My Head
videos.overview: Zara encourages a shy man who lives in his head to go for it with the woman of his dreams. Ruth's sense of self erodes as she regresses under the influence of Connie, while cracks start to show in Simon's resolve.

videos.title: Beautiful Sasha 25 xxx
videos.overview: Rob's determination to identify a dead man lands him in hot water. The partners discuss Simon, while Ruth and Connie battle for control - but who will win?

videos.title: From a Previous Marriage
videos.overview: When a young girl suspects her father and his girlfriend are hiding something from her, she asks Elaine for help, but the outcome is unexpected. Karen takes on a water-drinking challenge, while Heston tries to counsel Simon and Ruth faces the future.

videos.title: Who Do You Think You Are
videos.overview: When her boyfriend makes a surprise return from his travels, a student must face the consequences of her actions. Imogen has a surprise for Rob, while Cherry lifts Simon's spirits, unaware that an unexpected visitor threatens to ruin everything.

videos.title: The Mathematics of Marriage
videos.overview: Cherry's delight at seeing an old friend at the university soon turns to concern when she hears of her unique thesis. Ruth's attempts to cancel her gym membership do not go according to plan, while Najmah feels guilty for ranting at Simon - but is it too late?

videos.title: Body Language
videos.overview: Jack and Imogen spend an eventful day collecting for charity dressed as Santa's elves. Elaine and Cherry try to contact Simon, and Karen receives some news.

videos.title: These Boots
videos.overview: Julia tries to help an eccentric homeless man with no shoes in the depths of winter. The gang throw Ruth a surprise party at The Icon to celebrate her last day, and Simon is conspicuous by his absence.

videos.title: Signs and Wonders
videos.overview: When Elaine offers medical advice to a stranger, she has little idea of the effect this will have. A solemn mood hangs over the Mill as they prepare for a funeral.

videos.title: Candidate
videos.overview: A candidate for the receptionist's position faces a struggle to prove she is the woman for the job. The partners meet to discuss Simon, which unsettles Heston. Can Simon convince Cherry to go on her holiday with Jimmi?

videos.title: Kinesha
videos.overview: Rob works to free an incarcerated illegal immigrant on the brink of despair, surviving only through the comfort of her friend Kinesha.

videos.title: Cocktails For Two
videos.overview: Daniel helps the surgery cleaner when pretending to be someone else gets her into a tricky situation. It is Mrs Tembe's first day at the Mill, but has she seen enough to make her want to stay? Zara helps Sue come to terms with things, while Heston's outburst leaves Simon and Elaine reeling.

videos.title: What Yellow Brick Road?
videos.overview: Julia helps a runaway teen, determined to make her 16th birthday the best day ever. Mrs Tembe is not happy about working at The Campus; will the day's events change her mind? Simon's dad arrives and the strain of playing happy families starts to take its toll on him.

videos.title: An Inspector Calls
videos.overview: Heston tries to make an obsessed landlady see sense when she goes overboard in trying to keep one guest happy. Simon's parents continue to drive him insane.

videos.title: Jagged Little Pill
videos.overview: Karen reveals her secret and Simon speaks the truth, but will they be able to live with the consequences? Meanwhile, Mrs Tembe reaches out to Joshua.

videos.title: End of the Line
videos.overview: Heston tries to help Mrs Tembe, who is feeling hounded by Joshua, while Elaine does her best to keep Simon upbeat. When Karen and Rob finally start to talk all seems to be going well, until Rob puts his big foot in it.

videos.title: Sunny Side Up
videos.overview: Zara manages to inadvertently help Frank and Susie, who are stuck in a rut; Susie is desperate to have a baby, and Frank is feeling the pressure. Old memories are reignited for Simon when Elaine takes him on a surprise visit to the planetarium, while Rob tries to apologise to Karen.

videos.title: Born Evil
videos.overview:
In the course of a murder investigation, Rob meets a damaged and vulnerable teenage girl and inadvertently risks his own job and the investigation trying to help her.

Jack tries to help Karen come to a decision about her pregnancy. Elaine brings Simon to The Mill where he has a surprise visitor.

videos.title: The Cradle Rocks
videos.overview:
When a new mum starts acting strangely and her partner insists that everything is fine, her sister goes to Daniel for help but neither is prepared for the truth.

Simon and Najmah face the Hammond Case Review Panel while Jimmi causes a stir and Cherry receives some shocking news.

videos.title: The Passion of Oscar Wilde
videos.overview: Ciaran needs a new boyfriend. When he and his friend Shona overhear Jack talking on the phone to his mom, they convince themselves that he has been dumped, and Shona convinces Ciaran that Jack is gay. Mrs Tembe thinks the Mill could do with some cosmetic changes. Jimmi goes round to talk to Karen, but gets a shock at her reaction when Rob turns up.

videos.title: A Broken Heart
videos.overview:
Elaine treats a vicar's wife who is at a major crossroads in her life but will she follow her heart or her head?

Rob is given an unsettling new case while Imogen's distress manifests itself in an unexpected manner.

videos.title: Insomnia
videos.overview:
Mrs Tembe reassures a young churchgoer who is too frightened to sleep due to an intruder called the Letherbridge Leopard preying on young women.

Karen visits her friend for some advice and makes a huge decision about the baby. Simon drops a bombshell on Heston.

videos.title: My Hero
videos.overview: Security Guard Barry is an unlikely hero when Julia has the shopping experience from hell. Is Barry's heroism entirely selfless or does he have an ulterior motive? Zara helps Karen but is upset by the circumstances. Daniel is forced to console her.

videos.title: Dirty Doddering
videos.overview: Heston is called out for a home visit when an overprotective daughter panics at her elderly mother's breathlessness. It turns out the daughter is actually the one in need of help. Jack debates whether to tell Rob of Karen's decision.

videos.title: In the Queen's Arms Part 1
videos.overview: Danny wants to run a marathon in memory of his brother Jay who died in a hit and run. However Jay's ex-girlfriend has plans to wreak revenge upon those she deems responsible. Elaine gets an unexpected visitor, her spoilt younger sister Emma-Jane.

videos.title: In the Queen's Arms Part 2
videos.overview: Accused of torching the pub, Danny tries to get Sam to tell the truth but he runs into Parveen's brother Tahir and his gang, who are set on revenge. Elaine's sister attempts to relax like Elaine and has a huge revelation.

videos.title: White Out
videos.overview: Cherry sees Quinn with severe injuries on his hands and a reluctance to explain how he got them. He is haunted by nightmares, which are exacerbated by the arrival of a parcel. Karen grows suspicious when Daniel saves her from an inopportune meeting.

videos.title: Ring Me, Marry Me, Text Me, Kill Me
videos.overview: One tap of a mobile phone throws a spanner in the works for a man approaching his wedding day - can Daniel come to the rescue? Julia has a battle on her hands when Zara refuses to take part in her book group, while Imogen makes a promise she finds she cannot keep.

videos.title: August 23rd
videos.overview: Will Rob make it in time to be by Karen's side on the most difficult day of her life? Simon officially hands in his resignation, but Heston insists he work out his notice. Mrs Tembe bears the brunt of Simon's frustrations.

videos.title: Intereo Per Veneratio
videos.overview: An ex-soldier friend of Heston's is convinced that his late son has returned, but learns that his past is catching up with him when his friends start to die.

videos.title: The Sickest Kiss
videos.overview: Simon and Daniel clash over a teenage girl who may have been abused at the hands of her father - but who is reading the situation right? Final preparations are underway for the book group, while Imogen reacts badly when she learns that Karen has left.

videos.title: The Sparkling Spirit
videos.overview: When Jimmi's childhood penpal turns up, the pair of them learn some sickeningly touching lessons about themselves. At Julia's book group, attempts to cheer up Simon and even take the book seriously are unsuccessful.

videos.title: The Nun's Tale
videos.overview: Zara has her hands full when her formerly saintly cousin comes to stay. Mrs Tembe gives Cherry some unusual advice, while Daniel and Simon lock horns.

videos.title: Ab Flab
videos.overview: Cherry finds herself mediating when one member of a big girls' band has a secret which threatens to jeopardise the band's future. Mrs Tembe declares war on germs, while Jack worries about his family.

videos.title: Unkindness of Strangers
videos.overview: Julia learns a valuable lesson when she finds the personal diary of a young patient at the Mill. Elaine takes a reluctant Simon on an alternative therapy course, with surprising results.

videos.title: Sympathy for the Devil
videos.overview: Daniel is faced with a dilemma when a happy couple request a pregnancy termination, and events soon take a shocking turn. Mrs Tembe is on tenterhooks as she awaits royal news from Heston.

videos.title: Saints and Sinners
videos.overview: Jimmy helps a drugs worker who is out of his depth. Mrs Tembe's preparations to meet the Queen do not go to plan, while Jack starts to take some responsibility.

videos.title: Kings and Queens
videos.overview: While Elaine tries to help a bullied book publisher retain his dignity, Mrs Tembe is proud and excited to finally meet the Queen. What could possibly go wrong?

videos.title: Fit As A Fiddle
videos.overview: Heston is furious when a patient recovering from a heart attack ignores his advice. Mrs Tembe tries to retain her dignity as news of her disastrous meeting with the Queen spreads. When Jack meets his tutor, events take an unexpected turn and Karen returns home.

videos.title: Quarantine
videos.overview: The Mill is thrown into lockdown when the authorities suspect that someone inside is infected with a deadly virus. It is left to Simon to find out what is happening, but will he discover the truth in time?

videos.title: Ladies Who Lunch
videos.overview: An unexpected day off and a chance meeting throw Zara into the middle of a love triangle with two old friends. It is the day after the outbreak at the Mill, and everyone is on tenterhooks waiting for news on Cherry. Karen catches up with an old friend who wants to set her up on a blind date, but is she ready to move on? Jack decides to call things off with Lucy but his feelings get the better of him.

videos.title: Teenage Kicks
videos.overview: At the police station, Jimmi is left reeling when he discovers the risk a young single mum has taken to have a night out. Karen reluctantly goes on a date with an old friend; however, Angie fails to keep it under wraps! Jack and Lucy get intimate, and Cherry receives some welcome news.

videos.title: Time To Say Goodbye
videos.overview: It is an apprehensive day at the Mill as the decontamination process is finished, and Julia feels daunted by the task of getting it ready in time.

videos.title: Confessions
videos.overview: Immie and Belinda are at the Mill, shooting a documentary about life in the NHS. Immie though, gets all determined and seems to be so focused on the virus outbreak and the personal lives of the doctors that she misses the personal problems her friend is having, which include a very overbearing mother. Immie then totally overlooks her mother's contribution.

videos.title: Circling the Drain
videos.overview: Whilst visiting a sick member of her church in hospital, Mrs Tembe is shocked by the apparent lack of care, but her crusade to help has life-threatening consequences for one patient. Meanwhile, Cherry's over-enthusiasm for Jimmi's new car could put their relationship at risk.

videos.title: Shadows
videos.overview: Simon helps a blind man see the light, and faces some of his own demons in doing so. Imogen encourages Rob to get Karen back, Mrs Tembe worries about Lyme disease, and Jack makes Lucy promise her marriage is over.

videos.title: Strange Currency
videos.overview: Jack makes a decision about his relationship with Lucy when he is confronted by her husband. Daniel panics when Izzie goes missing at The Mill.

videos.title: Field Day
videos.overview: Daniel is suspicious when a fitness-obsessed elderly patient mixes up his prescriptions and his grandson is hanging around The Mill. Julia and Zara attend the PCT meeting.

videos.title: Elsewhere
videos.overview: On her first day of home visits, Karen finds herself embroiled in a case Rob is investigating. As their worlds collide, will it give them a chance to get back together?

videos.title: Happy Days
videos.overview:
David is a great guy, but he's also a manic depressive - Simon gets caught up in David's delusions as he tries to help him and his girlfriend come to terms with the illness.

Julia asks a delighted Elaine to the University Spring Ball, before embarking on an awkward shopping trip with Zara.

videos.title: Yes M'Lady
videos.overview: It's Immie's art project showing, but it doesn't get the reaction she was hoping for, especially from Jack! After the most terrible feedback, she decides she needs a treat. Cherry deals with a seemingly devoted butler who is trying to make his delusional, dying mistress' last days as comfortable as possible, despite arguments from her son. He seems to think that the butler is after her money!

videos.title: Cinderellas
videos.overview: Elaine, Daniel and Zara attend the University Spring Ball, but what has happened to Julia? Cherry's relaxing evening in with Jimmi is gate-crashed.

videos.title: No Regrets
videos.overview: Elaine has to treat a particularly grumpy old woman at a retirement home, and then becomes embroiled in a bogus cleaner's family history. Mrs Tembe's food shopping gives the nursing staff a shock, while Dav announces he needs to stay a little longer.

videos.title: The Abnormal Heart
videos.overview: Rob is asked to investigate complaints of indecency at a local gallery. This infuriates Imogen, who decides to make a stand for freedom of expression. Mrs Tembe's attempt at generosity backfires, and as a result it is pistols at dawn between her and Zara.

videos.title: There
videos.overview: Karen deals with a student whose act of revenge leads her and Rob to a near-death experience. Imogen is caught red-handed. Cherry tells Jimmi about Dav's roaming hands.

videos.title: Pavlova's Dogs
videos.overview: Rob's first evening back at home is less than straightforward, with a nosy neighbour, a noisy delinquent and a drunken Immie getting in the way of a soul-searching conversation with Karen.

videos.title: The Hoarse Whisperer
videos.overview: Simon tries to help a car salesman who has lost his voice win a contest to keep his job. Cherry gets a reality check from Dav, and will Mrs Tembe's second attempt at cooking for the team go better than the first?

videos.title: Jealous Girl
videos.overview: Sibling rivalry is finally dispelled as the awful truth of a hereditary genetic condition comes to the fore. Zara is finally forced to admit that she loves Daniel, while Cherry gets her own back on Dav.

videos.title: Relax and Rejuvenate
videos.overview: Julia accepts a free spa day, but as she becomes embroiled with women bent on revenge and an adulterous old friend, the results are far from relaxing! Daniel freaks out when he discovers Julia knows about his affair with Zara.

videos.title: Dare to Bare
videos.overview: Karen discovers that one of Rob's oldest friends has a shocking secret. Him and his wife are having an 80's party for their wedding anniversary, though he's also wearing women's clothes. His wife thinks he's having an affair though - with Karen. An old friend from hell of Cherrys calls her for a home visit. She has a nasty scar on her face, though she carries on treating Cherry exactly how she did many years ago.

videos.title: Pretending to See the Future
videos.overview: Elaine encounters a woman who claims to have travelled forward in time from 1990. Cherry confesses all about Dav - but who will Jimmi believe?

videos.title: Get Smart
videos.overview: Under pressure and with deadlines looming, Jack faces temptation and an ethical dilemma when he discovers a friend's new secret to success. Rob has to face Driver on his last day in CID, while Simon has an eventful first night on call.

videos.title: Six Feet Under
videos.overview: Jimmi is unnerved when he realises that one of his patients may have been buried in her back garden by her own husband. After his stabbing, Simon is rushed to St Phil's - but will he pull through?

videos.title: Chelsea Girl
videos.overview: Daniel treats an ex-model who believes that life is no longer worth living when she reaches the age of sixty.

videos.title: People Are Strange
videos.overview: When Imogen and a classmate embark upon an art project, they are unprepared for the horror that awaits them. Meanwhile, Zara starts to feel the strain of being the other woman, and Rob finds sending in his CID job application harder than he imagined!

videos.title: Hush Little Baby
videos.overview: Lisa takes stock of her life with Daniel and thinks about her future, while Julia's search for an exam gift for Simon leads her to play matchmaker when an old friend is abandoned by his wife.

videos.title: Green Shoots
videos.overview: Elaine looks forward to her blind date with Owain, but will it be a washout? There are mixed results when Lisa asks Daniel to look after Izzie, while Simon takes his final exam.

videos.title: Scratching An Itch
videos.overview: Heston finds himself embroiled in the affairs of his neighbour when a mystery insect is found. Simon struggles to deal with his exam results, while Daniel and Zara's afternoon liaison is interrupted, with shocking results.

videos.title: The Last Angel Cake
videos.overview: In a bid to win Simon over, Heston sends Mrs Tembe on a mission of vital importance. Daniel struggles to deal with Lisa's news, while Simon receives a life-changing emergency call.

videos.title: Dressed As Lamb
videos.overview: When Zara meets a quirky student, she is unprepared for the reality of her life. Daniel apologises to Zara, while Simon and Karen nervously prepare for dinner - but will it be a huge disaster?

videos.title: Every Heart That Beats
videos.overview: Elaine bashes into a QC's car in a car park. During the argument he has a heart attack, but Elaine saves his life. He turns up a month later wanting to do a good deed by helping the poor. It only gets both him and Elaine into a lot of trouble, especially when they find themselves at the top of a tall building trying to stop a tearful pregnant woman from jumping.

videos.title: A Life in the Day
videos.overview: Jack has his eyes opened when spending the day with Rob, and gets picked up by Andrea along the way! He's trying to write a thesis. Cherry tries everything to get Simon to stay at the Mill, but he's already announced his intention to leave to the partners. Cherry's very sad. Immie carries on stealing.

videos.title: Every Heart That Beats
videos.overview: Elaine becomes concerned about a man's obsession with "giving back" thirty minutes of his life. When he tries to help a woman dealing with a devastating loss, it puts them both in a life-or-death situatio

videos.title: Prestige
videos.overview: Heston's ego puts the Mill's reputation at risk when he does a favour for an old acquaintance. Will the daily grind of living together spell the end of the honeymoon period for Zara and Daniel? And will Karen's wifely wiles be enough to make Rob prepare for an important meeting?

videos.title: Thanks For The Memories
videos.overview: Mrs Tembe helps an old man whose unrequited love for his friend puts her in danger. How will Zara cope when Daniel's belongings start to take over her house? And will Rob's over-confidence be his downfall as he interviews for CID?

videos.title: Smoke and Mirrors
videos.overview: Julia smells a rat when her old friend claims she is being haunted by her dead husband. Rob finds out if he has got the job or not, but more importantly, will Karen get her conservatory? Heston is excited at the prospect of a blossoming romance, but has he been reading the signals correctly?

videos.title: Brothers
videos.overview: Jack sets out to uncover why his friend has dumped him, but can he handle the truth? Horrified by the idea of a double date, will Cherry and Zara be able to get out of it?

videos.title: Friday I'm In Love
videos.overview: Will Zara and Cherry survive date night without killing each other? Imogen is full of trepidation as she has her date with Ryan, but he manages to surprise her.

videos.title: Bad Heston - Part 1
videos.overview: Whilst investigating a cuckooing gang, Rob comes across a schizophrenic old acquaintance, Ed, who is in urgent need of medical assistance. Heston is drafted in to help, but Ed is a reluctant patient. Zara takes Daniel's advice to play nice with Cherry, something she later regrets.

videos.title: Bad Heston - Part 2
videos.overview: As Ed's vision, 'Bad Heston', continues to urge him to kill, Heston and Rob attempt to find him and get him the help he needs. But will they get to him before it is too late? Ryan tells Imogen she has to give up her illegal habit.

videos.title: Liar Liar
videos.overview: Cherry helps a patient deal with the consequences of sleeping with her sister's husband. And when Karen and Rob bump into Immie out shopping, can Ryan make a good impression? Heston worries that Elaine is feeling guilty over Ed.

videos.title: Just Like A Woman
videos.overview: Karen reluctantly goes to her friend Angie's lingerie party, and discovers that Angie's new best mate has a surprising secret! Elaine treads on toes when she fights for Ed's care at the hospital. When Immie tries to steal a birthday present for Ryan's mum, it has huge consequences for Ryan.

videos.title: Truth or Dare
videos.overview: Cherry is desperate to make a good impression at the party, but Zara is still doing her best to wriggle out of it; eventually the wine flows, and the truth comes out.

videos.title: Doric's Column
videos.overview: Mrs Tembe meets a man who has been spreading his obnoxious views around for several decades and finally teaches him to say what is really on his mind. Immie is desperate to find Ryan a new job, and Daniel apologises to Zara.

videos.title: Men and Motors
videos.overview: Jimmi deals with a man putting his health and freedom on the line in order to get his dream car. Zara visits her dad and attempts to avoid a difficult conversation. Elaine worries for Ed's future and considers how she can help.

videos.title: Spite Club
videos.overview: Heston becomes embroiled with best friends Sue and Joanne, who constantly bitch and snipe over an attractive assistant they both want to bed. Guilty Imogen decides to find Ryan a new job on campus, while Zara cannot stop smiling.

videos.title: Wrong Identity
videos.overview: When a former school friend and her sister are in trouble, Jack is eager to help, but playing the hero is not as straightforward as it seems. Zara has a proposition for Daniel, and Elaine welcomes Ed into her house, only to be plagued by doubts.

videos.title: Charade
videos.overview: When a rookie private detective and the woman he is supposed to be investigating arrive at The Mill, Julia sees romance while Zara sees stalking. But who is right? Zara and Daniel reach an impasse over three little words, and Karen looks forward to a quiet night in.

videos.title: Labyrinth
videos.overview: When Zara's old friend Jill arrives claiming to have forgotten to plan her best friend's wedding, Zara is forced to confront her own feelings for Daniel. But can she be persuaded to say those three little words? Meanwhile, Ed has his first therapy session.

videos.title: Light Blue Touch Paper
videos.overview: Rob catches a well-known prostitute trying to break into her own home. She claims she will be out of his hair very soon, but life is not that easy! It is Cherry's birthday and all she wants to do is house-hunt, but Jimmi is not too keen.

videos.title: The Silence
videos.overview: Ed discovers that an expose of his time in Afghanistan is missing some very important details. Elaine considers her friendship with Ed, while Mrs Tembe gets carried away with royal wedding hysteria.

videos.title: Elaine
videos.overview: Ed reveals he is off his medication, so Elaine instigates an emergency therapy session. She is making progress when Ed's father appears, wanting to take him back to Glasgow.

videos.title: Fruity
videos.overview: Mrs Tembe's looking after a friend's allotment, but gets involved in some very strange goings on. Elaine has a splinter, and Freya, underarm hair, though the underarm hair causes a bit of a stir. Rob takes Immie to see a solicitor, but it's all very horrible - she doesn't like it. When will she finally come clean?

videos.title: Protection
videos.overview: The dark racist underbelly of Letherbridge comes to the fore when the leader of the right-wing British Pride Party makes a speech. The Mill's cleaner accuses him of killing her son, and tries to blind him. This causes great consternation for Mrs Tembe who gets involved. Cherry tries to help a young girl who is in the early stages of TB.

videos.title: R.I.P.
videos.overview: Elaine is unsettled when she learns that one of her patients informed Lauren about her imminent death - he thinks he has a gift and can sense if people are going to die. Kevin gets interrogated by the police, but Rob and Driver wonder if he really is the murderer. Harrison takes his plan to frame Kevin to the next level. He gets his bag and plants some incriminating evidence in it. Jack makes the mistake of telling Harrison his reasons for thinking that Kevin isn't the murderer.

videos.title: Stealing His Thunder
videos.overview: Harrison pushes Rob in the direction of the murder weapon, knowing it will lead to them believing Kevin to be the murderer. He's planted at Kevin's Gran's grave. A rookie mistake though, threatens the investigation. Kevin continues to be interrogated. A burglar gets more than he bargained for when a desperate housewife seeks revenge on her husband Can Cherry unravel the truth before events spiral out of control?

videos.title: My Big Fat Ruined Wedding
videos.overview: The papers are blaming a police botch up for the release of Kevin from custody. Rob gets it in the neck from DCI Driver. Harrison suggests that Jack may somehow be involved, so he's next for questioning. Karen and Mrs Tembe are both unsure about Kevin returning to work. Karen also gets involved with a fraught bride to be on her wedding day. Her father doesn't want anything to do with the wedding, due to the fact the his daughter is a lesbian, and 'marrying' another woman.

Dougal and the Factory: Part Two
You Have the Right to Remain Silent
The Morning After and the Night Before
Let Me Shipwreck
videos.overview: Mandy attempts to help her patient Walt to resurface after he lost the love of his life ten years ago. Meanwhile, Freya's ego is boosted by the local press, but can she impress the partners enough to ensure they pick her over Kevin?

videos.title: Stuck
videos.overview: When Imogen is injured by a mugger she is paralysed with fear. Her parents risk their careers to get answers, but can Imogen find the courage to take control of the situation? Meanwhile, Zara joins a proactive group of mothers.

videos.title: The Promise
videos.overview: Tables are turned when an abusive husband is left at the mercy of his long-suffering wife. Freya finds herself compromised during a radio interview, while Zara has trouble finding a nanny for Joe.

videos.title: Pants on Fire
videos.overview: When Elaine manages to get two of her sisters together, a whole series of ridiculous lies come to light. But when their respective husbands also make an appearance, can Elaine manage to keep a lid on the truth?

videos.title: Dinosaurs
videos.overview: Karen's dinner party descends into chaos after the details are unwittingly put on a social networking site. Daniel and Zara are thrilled to use Joe as an excuse to escape the party, but their night of relaxation does not quite go to plan.

videos.title: Full Time
videos.overview: Heston returns to work full of exciting tales of travelling but is not completely honest.

videos.title: Deal or No Deal
videos.overview: A mother resorts to desperate measures in order to repay her debts.

videos.title: A Suburban Affair
videos.overview: Daniel becomes involved in affairs of the heart when a wife exacts revenge on her husband.

videos.title: Bursting Balloons
videos.overview: Heston is back on form but there is a shock in store at the end of the night.

videos.title: Reality Check
videos.overview: After a run-in with the law, Rob tries to convince a teenager to put his past behind him.

videos.title: A Little on the Side
videos.overview: Cherry's principles are tested when she discovers her cousin has been doing the dirty.

videos.title: Dancing Queen
videos.overview: Freya tries to help a junkie so desperate that she endangers her sister's dream.

videos.overview: Mrs Tembe tries to help a member of her church whose pride has affected her children.

videos.overview: Mandy plays peace maker when her cousin makes a shock announcement.

videos.overview: It's Zara's first day back at work so she throws herself into helping a lecturer.

videos.overview: Zara faces a crisis when the truth about 'nannycam' comes out.

videos.overview: Daniel struggles to meet Zara's expectations when caring for Joe.

videos.overview: Heston faces the consequences of his actions in defending his home.

videos.overview: Rob witnesses a tragedy unfold as young Dane refuses to accept his mother has moved on.

videos.overview: A burgeoning relationship is threatened by a shocking revelation.

videos.overview: Kevin encounters a patient who cannot help winding people up.

videos.overview: Mandy determines to help a childhood hero with a terminal illness.

videos.overview: Karen's inclination to play Good Samaritan puts Jack at risk from a femme fatale.

videos.overview: Daniel realises he needs to practice what he preaches when it comes to bedside manners.

videos.overview: Imogen finds herself in a curious predicament when a friend asks her to cover for them.

videos.overview: Kevin helps a returning backpacker with an unusual souvenir of his travels.

videos.overview: A student protest causes a rift between Mandy and Freya.

videos.title: Summit Fever
videos.overview: Zara tries her best to get on with a critical Marion but is later in for a shock when she snoops in her bag. Elsewhere, Rob seems to have new doubts about fostering, and Emma finds a new escapism for her troubles.

videos.title: Mirror Touch
videos.overview: Feelings are running high. Emma feels unsupported, while Zara struggles to ignore Marion, and Mrs Tembe faces more hostility from Valerie. Elsewhere, Jimmi sees a patient with an unusual condition that means she literally feels the pain of others.

videos.title: Water Babies
videos.overview: Ruhma delivers devastating news to a couple expecting twins, leaving them with a difficult decision to make. Elsewhere, Zara opens up about her real worries, and Mrs Tembe is at breaking point, but Emma knows exactly how to make her feel better.

videos.title: Skydayze
videos.overview: Heston sees a schoolgirl who is playing a deadly game. He races to save her, but will he get there in time? Zara's attempt to bury the hatchet with Marion leads to a confession, and Emma's game playing takes a darker turn.

videos.title: Duncan Day
videos.overview: Al learns something about getting his priorities right when he helps a young girl displaying symptoms of iron poisoning. Meanwhile, Daniel has some bad news for Valerie and Marion, but can he persuade Zara to help him?

videos.title: The Best of Intentions
videos.overview: An under-pressure charity worker requires Mrs Tembe's help to save a children's centre, otherwise his life's work could go to ruin. Valerie looks set to flunk her job interview, while Sid finds the new challenge he has been looking for.

videos.title: Blood Line
videos.overview: A man with a rare degenerative condition fears that his son may have inherited it too, but when his ex-wife comes back into his life, she drops a bombshell. Shak and Alia discuss their biological father, while Emma finds temptation on the high street.

videos.title: Ladies of the Day
videos.overview: When a middle-aged prostitute is beaten up, Ayesha helps her realise that it is time to tell her son the truth about how she earns a living. Heston falls for Shak's ploy when they go bowling together, and Karen and Rob's relationship is tested when they attend foster training.

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye Baby
videos.overview: Ruhma's interest in a patient's relationship makes her slow to pick up that the patient is suffering from an acute phobia of childbirth. Alia and Shak find what they are looking for, and Emma urges Zara to make some friends at the school gate.

videos.title: Art for Art's Sake
videos.overview: Valerie and Sid embark on an artistic 'experience' where they navigate the seven sins in a big brother-style project to expose corruption in the art world.

videos.title: A History of Violence
videos.overview: When an elderly couple's home is petrol bombed, Rob discovers that their neighbour's teenage daughter has links to an extremist group. But can he prove she caused the fire? Valerie gets a surprise leaving do, and Zara finds making friends at Joe's school a challenge.

videos.title: Leave and Cleave
videos.overview: Jimmi has to deal with a fraught marriage and discovers that the problem might be closer to home than the couple think. Shak has new information for Alia, but will she convince him to tell Ruhma? Karen is struggling to make an appointment with her GP so has to ask for help. But who will help her?

videos.title: Sins of the Father
videos.overview:
Zara meets a school friend for lunch, but events take a nasty turn when her friend is knocked down by a car.
